It was found that LSTM models were more suitable for short as well as long term time-series forecasting as compared to RNN model.

articleTitle: Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna Design for 2.1 GHz and 2.3 GHz- 4G Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Wireless communication is the system which is performed and delivered wirelessly where the antenna plays a vital role in next generation mobile communication networks. The fourth generation mobile communication that is Long Term Evolution (LTE) transceiver is mainly depends on Microstrip Patch Antenna (MPA). The shape of the antenna may be any type but most commonly used configuration is rectangular as a conducting patch of an antenna. The Rectangular Microstrip Patch Antenna (RMPA) designed for 2.1 GHz and 2.3 GHZ frequencies for mobile applications. The simulation result offers improved antenna parameters such as return loss, bandwidth and percentage bandwidth for the optimized design of 4G LTE band of frequency.

articleTitle: Experience of a Gamified Spelling Solving by Students for Learning Spelling: Development of Kids Spell Dzongkha App
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In recent years a trend of gamification can be seen in every filed of education. However, there is a gap in research on the applicability of gamification in education, with few studies available. Therefore, this study seeks to investigate gamified spelling learning with focus on how Bhutanese kids experience learning English spelling through playing “EDUBUZZ kids” English spelling game app. By which study aims to develop similar kind of app for Dzongkha spelling learning for Bhutanese students to learn their national language easily. Study was conducted by allowing 10 participants to play the English spelling game and by performing the spelling test and interview before and after playing the game. The spelling test score before and after playing game was analyzed and found there was significant difference between two scores resulting to improvement of scores with game. Analysis from interview questions found that gamification of English spelling learning can be useful for rising interest and easy learning remembering it for longer duration than that of classroom learning. Through the above results authors of this study have found need of similar app for learning Dzongkha spelling. And the development of Kids Spell Dzongkha came in.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement using Custom Power Devices (AVC, DVR, APC)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Power Quality exertion has happen to more complex at all stages of power system. Nowadays a new concept of custom power is used for customer's satisfaction. This paper presents a wide-ranging survey of custom power devises in order to get better quality of power. Custom power devices (CPDs) with DVR, AVC and APC be replicated on the customized IEEE 16 bus radial division scheme by Matlab to examine efficiency of every device in a variety of PQ disorders together with voltage sags, harmonic distortions and voltage disturbance. Results of this work show that the application of every apparatus to recompense dissimilar PQ disorders depend on the device's features.

articleTitle: Query Driven implementation of Twitter base using Cassandra
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: With big data challenges rising in the recent years, NoSQL databases have witnessed a surge in popularity, thus challenging the dominance of relational databases. These next generation databases focus on being non-relational, distributed, open source and horizontally scalable. Cassandra being one of them is a high performance database proficient in handling large volumes of data stored across data centers, providing high availability, fault tolerance and tunable data consistency. However, unlike SQL and MongoDB, Cassandra doesn't support adhoc queries and hence requires an efficient data model largely driven by the kind of query intended to be performed majorly on the database. Social Networking sites like Twitter stores millions of tweets per day leading to large number of read and write operations on a regular basis. This paper suggests a query driven data model in Cassandra to store tweets and maintain user's timeline so that read and write operations can be performed in an efficient way.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna for WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this article, square shaped patch antenna for WLAN purpose is planned and designed. The antenna structure has a square shaped spiral antenna. The FR4 substrate is used with the thickness of 3.2mm. The substrate dimension is 48.83mm x 34.48mm x 3.2mm. The proposed antenna operates at 2.4 GHz with return loss and voltage standing wave ratio of -39.4407 dB and 1.02 respectively. The dimension of the resonator is 8.2mm x 8.2 mm. The bandwidth of proposed antenna is 593MHz. The performance of the antenna is analyzed by varying feed position, feed width and substrate thickness. The better performance is affined at center feed position with 2mm of feed width at the substrate thickness of 3.2mm.

articleTitle: Association Rule Mining Approach to Analyze Road Accident Data
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: One of the key targets in twist of fate information analysis is to become aware of the primary factors related to an avenue traffic coincidence. However, heterogeneous nature of street twist of fate data results in the evaluation tough. Records has been used extensively to triumph over this heterogeneity of the twist of fate facts. So as to conquer heterogeneity we propose a technique to categorize the twist of fate information into different classes. Herewe use clustering as a preliminary mission for segmentation of 21,436 road injuries on road community of united kingdom between 2009 and 2016 (each inclusive). On clustered records affiliation rule mining method (apriori algorithm) is carried out to become aware of the semantics of coincidence incidence and to quantify quantity of accident occurrences based on type of vehicle, weather conditions, lighting fixtures.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Social Spider Optimization Algorithm for Fuzzy Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Fuzzy clustering is a significant research problem in quite a lot of real time applications. Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) is a well-known prominent fuzzy clustering algorithm easily trapped in local optima. For solving local optima, recently, social spider optimization is use as a proposed model for solving global optima problem based on the replication of cooperative performance of social spiders. In this paper, the traditional social spider optimization algorithm is an integrated with fuzzy theory for solving clustering problem which is refer to fuzzy social spider optimization (FSSO). The experimental result shows that the proposed fuzzy social spider optimization clustering algorithms reveal better performance for solving clustering problems.

articleTitle: Real Time Gesture to Automotive Control
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Real Time Gesture to Automotive Control (G2AC) system is developed in this paper, using hand gesture recognition to handle the media player in automotive. The system presents fast gesture recognition with low complexity algorithms for controlling real-time media in automotive systems. In the proposed vision-based system two modules are interconnected: one module recognizes the hand gesture in the region of interaction and another module does the task of selection of music from the media player using Raspberry pi. The proposed G2AC system is able to recognize real time hand gestures with 98 percent accuracy which is demonstrated using a hand gesture data set collected under different settings of illumination variation, hand orientation and occlusion.

articleTitle: Detecting Hard Exudates In Retinal Fundus Images Using Convolutinal Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The main objective of this project is to detect Exudates in retinal fundus images using Convolutinal neural networks. Disorders in Retinal Images like Micro aneurysm, Hemorrhages', Hard Exudates, Soft Exudates, Macular Edema, Red lesions, Diabetic Retinopathy are likely to lead to severe visual loss Impairments. This work provides an automatic image processing techniques to diagnose Exudates in human eye and discussed various approaches used to detect Exudates in retinal images. Various publically available databases are listed and provide comparison between different approaches like SVM, KNN and CNN. Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is the most essential causes of imaginative and prescient loss in diabetic patients. The most primary sign of DR is the presence of exudates, and detecting these in early screening is crucial in preventing vision loss. The automatic reputation of DR consisting of lesions, they are hard exudates (HEs), in fundus pix can make contributions to the diagnosis of this disease. On this take a look at, a fixed of functions from image regions are extracted and decided on the subset which quality discriminates between HEs and the retinal historical past. In proposed system, threshold based segmentation is used for extracting the features. After that, HOG (histogram of gradient), Classify the diseases using the convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classifier. The publicly available STARE of color fundus images was used for testing purposes and the values of sensitivity, specificity and accuracy were found as 96%, 98% and 99.68% respectively for the neural network based classification.

articleTitle: A Novel Seven Level Asymmetrical Inverter Topology to Reduce Total Harmonic Distortion
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Multilevel converters offer high power capability, associated with lower output harmonics and lower commutation losses. Application of multilevel inverters for higher voltage goals in renewable energy has become more popular. The multi level inverters are mainly used for reduction of total harmonic distortion without filter requirement in the circuit. This paper proposes new inverter topology for seven level voltage output response. In this proposed inverter topology, less number of switches are used for output response.

articleTitle: Restaurant's Feedback Analysis System using Sentimental Analysis and Data Minining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: There are many challenges faced by restaurants of which getting honest feedbacks of the services have been a huge challenge but it is equally very important to remain on the top of the current market. The current trend and fact are; people express their honest sentiments through social media. Hence, through this paper, we present a methodology that will quell this challenge by performing sentimental analysis on the feedbacks and determine their polarity. Followed by clustering on the positive and negative feedbacks obtained from the previous process, to identify the broad topics of that organization that the feedbacks target. This summarization helps the restaurants to improve their current processes based on the feedback received. The feedbacks are collected from different sources to suffice the needs.

articleTitle: Multi-Input Interleaved DC-DC Converter with Low Current Ripple for Electric Vehicle Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-input interleaved DC-DC converter with reduced current ripple is designed. The interleaving structure present in the front end side of the converter reduces the current ripple. Switched capacitors are present at output side which provides wide input voltage gain. Multi-input makes the converter to gather input from multiple sources like solar array, battery, super-capacitors etc. Here two converters with different sources are paralleled so that if one of the sources is absent, the output remains the same. Duty cycle adjustment based closed loop control is adopted here. The output of the converter is given to a three phase inverter to control the BLDC motor that can be used for electric vehicle application.

articleTitle: Improved Synchronization and Voltage Regulation of DFIG based Wind Energy System (WES)
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper proposes the control scheme for improving synchronization of WES connected to grid or microgrid without PLL. The proposed control scheme is based on droop control to obtain proper voltage regulation and frequency control under weak grid or micro-grid environment. The transient and dynamic response is also improved with proposed control scheme as compared to conventional control scheme. DFIG based WES is modelled in MATLAB SIMULINK to implement the proposed control scheme. The Simulation results are discussed to validate the improvement in power quality and Synchronization of DFIG based WES with Proposed control. The results are also compared with conventional control scheme to demonstrate the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Impact of Line Outage in Modern Power System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Nowadays the power system is becoming complex day by day due to increased loading. In deregulated power system, the system has to deal with the varying load under open access. This results in gradually increased power flow level leading to more and more stress on the power system. Under such stressed condition, if line outage occurs, this may cause a voltage stability problem as well as linepower flow problem. So, it has become essential to study the impact of line outage in power system so that control actions can be taken accordingly by power system operators. This paper presents the impact of contingency due to line outage in a comprehensive manner. The voltage profile of buses is analyzed with PV curve under contingency cases. The post contingency power flow and voltage angles are also compared with the base case. The proposed methodology has been tested for standard IEEE 5 bus, IEEE 14 bus and IEEE 30 bus system to check the various important parameters and effectiveness. However this study will be helpful for power system researchers, planners, academicians to carry out the various analysis and for decision making to maintain a reliable, secure and stable power system.

articleTitle: Trend square: An Android Application for Extracting Twitter Trends Based on Location
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The identification of popular and important topics discussed in social networks is crucial for a better understanding of societal concern. Without having to explore the vast amount of information, it helps users to be aware of the trends around them. Trend detection methods introduced so far have not used the location matching feature thus lack integrating geographic locations information with the analyzed trend. To address this problem, this research aims at developing an Android mobile application, TrendSquare which uses LDA topic modeling algorithm to obtain location-specific trending tweets. This is not an exhaustive trend analysis of all services, because of the vast amount of tweets present; rather it is for picked services (Restaurants, Jewelry, Shopping malls, Textiles) where trend notifications to customers would serve as a prominent way of advertising and target marketing. An outstanding advantage of using LDA for Twitter trend detection is that it can well capture events with narrow topical scope. This implementation also provides us favorable results in the accuracy of trends obtained.

articleTitle: A Review on Protection of Capacitor in Power Quality Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In large industry, power factor has become a majorissue in power system. Many industries have been using a capacitor bank for power factor improvement and reactive power compensation. With the use of capacitor bank, disturbance such as inrush current is increased in the system and can cause damage to the capacitor banks and other nearby equipment. This paper aims to study issues in terms of inrush current in the industry and its effect after switching the capacitor bank. The capacitor bank is used in industry for system stability, power factor improvement, and reactive power compensation. To reduce the switching transients of the capacitor bank, pre-insertion resistor technique is used. Most of the industrial loads are nonlinear in nature which aims at lagging power factor. To avoid this problem, capacitor banks are installed in the system. After switching to a capacitor bank, disturbances are increased, thus, the protection scheme is fulfilled for the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Single Stage PV Water Pumping System With MPPT Employing Three Phase Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In recent years, solar photovoltaic systems have become more popular and today, this technology has become the application of interest mainly in isolated areas where the power grid is not accessible. Generally, PV fed dc motors are used because of their robust construction and ease to control. However, dc motors need to be frequently maintained due to its commutator and carbon brush. Hence in this paper, centrifugal pump driven by three-phase induction motor is considered. To power the three-phase induction motor, a three-phase voltage source inverter is used which performs two functions, viz., (i) converts the Maximum Power-Point dc voltage into three-phase ac voltage (ii) changes the frequency of the three-phase ac voltage and helps the system to guide at the Maximum Power Point.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna for 4G Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper, a microstrip patch antenna for 4G communications is designed. The proposed antenna operates at 1.8 GHz resonant frequency for 4G communication. The proposed antenna designed with square shaped slot in a rectangular patch antenna. The substrate material used in the proposed antenna is FR4 substrate and has the relative permittivity of 4.4. The dimension of the substrate is 48.24 mm * 38.73 mm and 0.8 mm thickness. The proposed antenna has been simulated by using HFSS software. The proposed antenna resonates at 1.8 GHz with the return loss and voltage standing wave ratio of -29.19 dB and 1.07, respectively. The performance of the antenna is analyzed by varying feed position, feed width, slot length and slot width.

articleTitle: Detection of Abnormalities in Ultrasound Images Using Texture and Shape Features
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Cancer is curable if detected at an early stage. Breast cancer, a common form of cancer in women is a leading cause of death in women. There are many imaging modalities to detect breast cancer. But ultrasound imaging is most frequently used for clinical diagnosis of breast cancer, as it is painless and safe. The presence of speckle in ultrasound images reduces the image quality, thereby affecting the accuracy in diagnosis. For effective interpretation of the abnormal images, speckle has to be removed. Image segmentation plays a crucial role in US images for detecting abnormalities. The segmentation of lesion is done using level set method. Once the lesion is segmented, features, characteristic of the lesions are to be extracted. Texture and Shape features are proved to be appropriate for characterizing normal and abnormal tissues. Texture features that refer to surface characteristics and shape features that refer to content description are extracted. All features extracted are not significant between benign and malignant lesions. Hence, statistical analysis of the features are done using Statistical Packages for Social Sciences, to determine the significant features.

articleTitle: Data mining a way to solve Phishing Attacks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: With the ever increasing use of Internet by different stake holders in various fields, information on web browsers and servers is highly susceptible to different security attacks. Though high security measures and enhanced techniques are used to protect the information on the web browsers and servers, they are still prone to a number of attacks. Phishing is one such type of attack in which users are tricked by the phishers using social engineering methods to steal their personal or confidential information. Detection of phishing attack with high accuracy is a challenging research issue. Users are duped by the phishers to enter their confidential information into websites created by them and thereby are steal the vital user's credentials. Phishing sites are normally detected by using blacklist based approach but this approach fails as white listed phishing sites cannot be detected using this approach. This research work aims to use data mining algorithms to analyze E-mails and also helps in preventing phishing attacks. This paper proposed an architectural model to differentiate between the fake E-mail and real E-mail with a high accuracy and use naive Bayesian classification for the said purpose. The proposed algorithm works in various stages for fake E-mail detection and hence tries to protect the users from leaking their confidential information.

articleTitle: A Personalized Recommendation System using Memory-Based Collaborative Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In recent years, with the exponential increase in Web usage, Recommendation Systems are being popularly used by various E-commerce sites to give remarkable recommendations to their users, such that the users as well as providers will get benefited. This paper presents a Personalized Recommendation System, which gives top most recommendations to both registered and unregistered users. The proposed Personalized Recommendation System is based on the most popular Collaborative Filtering (CF) technique, which uses the Item ratings available with the registered users' profile to provide recommendations. The performance of the proposed system is 10-fold cross validated on benchmark BookLens and MovieLens datasets of GroupLens Repository.

articleTitle: Power-Efficient p-Cycle Protection with Power Conscious Routing in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: With rapid increase in power consumption in information and communication technology (ICT], there is need of power-efficient solutions in telecom networks. Elastic optical networks (EONs), as spectrum efficient and flexibility in bandwidth, are also major contributor in the overall power consumption. There is immense amount of data transmission in the network and any loss of data due to network failure can incur huge losses. In order to meet this high reliability requirement, network architectures are deployed with a large number of redundant resources to provide the backup protection. These redundant resources are also major contributor to overall power consumption. Shortest path routing (SPR) is employed in some power saving strategies. This paper considers power efficient protection with power conscious routing (PCR) in EONs against single link failure by using preconfigured cycles (p-cycles). An integer linear programme (ILP) has been developed to optimize total required power consumption. Optimization of power consumption is based on PCR and selection of p-cycle by maximizing number of idle network resources be put into sleep mode. Numerical results show that the power consumption during low traffic with PCR is lesser than SPR. In addition, it is seen that as the traffic increases, the power consumption saturates.

articleTitle: Recent Challenges and Opportunities of Electrical Generation and Distribution in Rural Area of India
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The perspective of this paper is to categorize key factors which are projected to lead the power generation and distribution in Urban and Rural India with associated opportunities and challenges now a days. It provides an overview of the issues and challenges for distribution quality. The preliminary investigation has discovered some interesting conclusion which is tried to explain in detail in the paper. The paper exclusively confers the problems with respect to urban and rural level electricity generation and distribution.

articleTitle: Islanding Phenomena In Microgrid based on PV Generation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The paper presents the comparative study of grid connected Photovoltaic system during its parallel operation with main grid and its autonomous operation as an electric island. The irradiation condition of PV as a function of time is varied to study the power fluctuation arising in the PV array. The main grid is disconnected intentionally at a time being to show the load profile following the characteristics of PV power. The behavior of grid connected PV system is analyzed during its pre-islanding condition and at the instant of formation of islands. The system is modelled in MATLAB and the results are analyzed to study the exact voltage variations occurring on load side due to islanding of the system.

articleTitle: A Study on Transaction Specification based Software Testing for Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Automated testing techniques for software design specification include model-based approaches that generate test cases from a coding or state machine model of the interface, capture-replay methods that require the user to specify and demonstrate each test case individually, and modelling-language approaches that provide templates for abstract test cases. In this paper elucidates a method for automatic software analysis testing for IoT service. Nowadays real-time IoT software is used to satisfy the needs and functions of a user and it is assisted in this by the hardware. Software testing is generally used to detect bugs and errors and eliminate them to produce a high quality, reliable software. The automated testing depends on the kind of approach taken. This testing may be poorly implemented which results in a low quality software or it may be effectively implemented which results in a high quality software. Automated IoT software testing can decrease time and cost. When these techniques are identified, the cost and time can be reduced. The automated testing is based on three steps such as analyzing the test case, test execution and log analyzer. These steps provide user friendly software with high standard. The automated process provides test reusability and repeatability and saves the test coverage cost and time. In this paper compare the automated software testing for IoT transactions and system peripherals such as sensor, DMA controller, internal counters, physical layer, and virtual layer using IoT specification based software testing.

articleTitle: Power Fluctuation Reduction Using Battery System In DFIG Based Wind Energy Conversion System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Wind energy conversion system (WECS) is the most popular renewable energy resource. This paper discusses about the usage of a battery in a grid interfaced doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) system for power smoothing. Battery energy storage system (BESS) is introduced into de-link to avoid power variation due to varying nature of wind. Thevenin equivalent model of the lead acid battery is employed in this work. Active power is maximized by using rotor side converter (RSC) controller. Grid side converter (GSC) is used to obtain unity power factor operation and constant output power. The performance of the proposed system is verified by simulating in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Common Control Channel Based Spectrum Handoff Framework for Cognitive Radio Network
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Cognitive Radio Network (CRN) has been emerged as a hopeful solution to utilize a statically allocated spectrum in an optimistic manner with dynamic spectrum access. At present, there is no workflow describe the way of whole data transmission including all the spectrum functionalities. This research work presents a framework of the CRN based on Common Control Channel (CCC) with a notion concerning channel selection algorithm, spectrum sensing and spectrum handoff to avoid collision between users and improve the throughput of Secondary Users (SUs) without affecting Primary Users (PUs). This research concentrates CCC based control message exchange along with design and finds CCC is optimal. Finally, this research proposed framework for CCC based channel selection and spectrum handoff to CRN.

articleTitle: Prototype Architecture to Control Building Energy Usage Using PLC and CPS
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In today's word to do almost any day to day activity energy is used by everyone at different places such as home, work place etc. It has been used in industries, transportation, and entertainment, at home for cooking, washing, cooling, lighting and so on. The energy demand has increased hugely and need has risen to find solution to conserve it, save it and use it systematically. The utilization of energy especially at home is increasing and hence the overall usage of energy is also increased in domestic sector. This is a sector in which by using some simple methods or ways the improper usage and wastage of energy can be avoided by deploying smart circuitry in home without much additional infrastructure. This article represents the system to manage home energy and eventually to manage energy for the building. The main system component of proposed system is PLC based renewable energy gateway, communicating power supply (CPS) and a wireless sensor network (WSN). The real time data of different home servers from the several building should be collected by central system and can be stored on cloud using IOT.

articleTitle: State-Space Stator-Flux Model of 3-phase Induction Motor using LabView
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper deals with stator flux-based state space model of a balanced 3-phase Induction Motor(IM). The proposed standard has been implemented in numerical simulation in LabVIEW (Control & Simulation Package). The main aspects of the proposed model are to model the machine considering the entire set of state variables which is useful in FOC, DTC.

articleTitle: Reduction of Odd Harmonics using Multilevel Inverter with Multi Carrier PWM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The role of multi level inverter's are increasing day by day due to the impact of renewable energy resources. But in general all the renewable resources are in form of DC, but the utilization is in AC form. This paper aims to reduce the harmonic content in the inverter output. The H Bridge seven level is considered in this paper. The multi carrier PWM routineare used to reduce the total harmonic distortions. The simulation result shows the THD level reduction by these methods.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Negative Output Luo Converter for Power Quality Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper displays the investigation and outline of a negative output Luo converter for the enhancement of power quality as far as enriched power factor and less source current Total Harmonic Distortion (THD). This negative output Luo converter can be used for all kind of AC-DC applications operating under the universal supply voltage of 90 V-260 V. This converter either works in Continuous Conduction Mode (CCM) or Discontinuous Conduction Mode (DCM). The proposed work focuses on a power factor corrected negative output Luo converter operating in DCM of inductor current improves the power factor at AC mains nearly to unity and thereby reducing the THD under the prescribed limits of IEEE and IEC standards. The performance of the proposed converter is analysed using MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Chopper circuits in MPPT for Solar PV applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A comparative assessment of chopper topologies and their effectiveness in tracking the Maximum Power Point (MPP) of a Photovoltaic (PV) system output is presented. This study considers different choppers like Buck, Boost, Buck-Boost, CUK and Fly back converter topologies used as intermediate for maximum power point tracking (MPPT) in (PV) system. Variation of performance in power electronic converter with change is atmospheric conditions is the primary comparative tool. MATLAB/SIMULINK platform is used to develop the modelling and implementation of the tracking algorithms. The impact of the converters tracking ability with respect changes in atmospheric parameters (solar radiation and temperature) has been carried out with Perturb and Observe (P&O) based tracking algorithms. Simulation results show that the CUK converter controlled by Perturb and Observe (P&O) based MPPT provides better output response with settling time (t<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</sub>)0.5 second and no overshoot. It has also been observed that respect to the tracking of solar P. V modules moment to moment change in effective MPP due to changes in ambient conditions.

articleTitle: A Framework for Efficient Virtual Machine Migration
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Economical resource management could also be a really necessary part in cloud-based solutions. Virtualization could also be a standard resolution that acts as a main source for provisioning wants of a cloud-based resolution. Virtualization creates a virtual version of a device or resource used to instantiate virtual machines (VMs). VM migration is that the strategy of transfer of memory pages of VM from one machine to other machine. VM Migration (VMM) possess a current draw back to vogue efficient and smart migration procedures that employment nearly as good like a full heap of VMs and servers at intervals. In the previous work, they have advocated the utilization of common established identical structure from economic to resolve different networking problems, and it as long as it offers distinctive blessings related to different value-based improvement, using a procedure of delay acceptance. Throughout this paper, we've an inclination to use this structure to the VM migration draw back, associate degree propose egalitarian procedure that looks for a established matching truthful to every virtual machine and servers, instead of vowing either side as a results of the delayed approval technique. Such academic degree open established matching that reduces the general rank adds of the results shown to be a wise notion of equality beneath minor conditions.

articleTitle: Effect of Tuning Parameter on the Stability of the TDF-IMC Scheme for Load Frequency Control
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Effect of tuning parameter on the stability of the TDF-IMC for load frequency control is studied. Choice of an optimal value is found to be directly affecting the feedback filter (Qd) and depends on the nature of model order reduction scheme used (such as Padé approximation, Routh and SOPDT). The findings corroborate with our previously published results, that the bi-parametric variation in (Tg-Tt) can be effectively mitigated by preferring SOPDT in comparison to Pade and Routh for an optimal tuning parameter. Further, the response to disturbance is quick and damps swiftly with low amplitude oscillations. In conclusion, we identify that the SOPDT offers better performance at optimal tuning parameter (depending on the design preference for the gain and phase margin).

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Single-Switch Non-Isolated DC-DC Converter Employing TEG using MPPT Control Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In recent years, conversion of waste heat into electricity has become an engaging option in both research and industries. Usual waste heat recovering techniques mostly use Thermo Electric Generator (TEG) for the transition of thermal energy into electrical energy. Single Switch Non-Isolated DC-DC converter is wished for the thermo electric power gener at ionsystems. The proposed Converter has the advantage of using only ones witch. Consequently, selection of the switch with low-on-state-resistance reduces the loss during conduction of switch as well as increase the efficiency. Additionally MPPT using the Cuckoo Search (CS) and Incremental Conductance (INC) techniques are used. Proposed converter is designed with MPPTcontrollerusing MATLAB.

articleTitle: An Optimised BCD Digit Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Decimal multiplication plays an important role in the field of banking, tax calculation, accounts fixation etc. This paper aims at providing a new architectural design for fixed point BCD product calculation. The proposed BCD digit multiplier includes two stages, first being the BCD digit multiplier yielding a binary product followed by a binary to BCD converter module. It is observed from the simulation results that the proposed multiplier achieves a reduction in terms of area and delay when compared to the existing designs in computing the BCD product.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Measure of a Sentence
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A sentence is a group of words that must expresses a complete idea or sense or meaning. The meaning of a sentence depends primarily on the use of appropriate words. Confusion arises when there are multiple options (synonyms) available for a word. In this work, we introduce a vulnerability measure of a sentence that tries to define the amount of ambiguity due to the various options available for words used in the sentence. This measure facilitates the authors or copy editors to identify the vulnerable sentences in a document. Though the selection of appropriate words depends on the context, here we have just considered the synonyms of the words and defined the measure.

articleTitle: A New Method for Improving the Security and Access Time to Data Blocks in Big Databases
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Big Data is a set of data with large volume, a various and complex structure and their size is beyond of limit which can be grasped, managed and processed with usual softwares in a reasonable time. Data volume in the world is increasing day to day. Traditional database systems are not able to save and analyze so much data volume. Because the internet is growing, Big Data volume is growing too. Organizations have become very flexible and open. New data types will make new challenges. One of the key challenges in Big Data is security. According to the increasing volume and variety of Big Data, security challenges will grow too. From the other side, software infrastructures like Hadoop make it possible for extenders to process in thousands of nodes parallel. In this paper, a review will be done on Big Data and security challenges and a method will be offered for improving the efficiency of security and access time to data blocks in Big Data.

articleTitle: A Prototype Model of Flap like Propulsion System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper is intended to demonstrate the idea of fish/flap like propulsion which is a modification to conventional propulsion system in marine technology. This is a scale down model of a boat name as `TBR 52D' by TBR marines, Germany. After construction of the body adequate size of the fish like propulsion units were fitted on the prototype model. The speed of both flaps with 6V PMDC motor for the prototype float are made with Styrofoam and acrylic sheets. The constructional detail has been laid down and testing the efficiency and power have been calculated.

articleTitle: Super Strongly Perfect Structure of Mobius Ladder Graphs
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A graph G is SSP (Super Strongly Perfect) if in every induced subgraph H of G there exists a dominating set which is minimal that covers every maximal cliques of H. This paper investigates the SSP ness in Mobius ladder graphs. Also, it discusses the SSP parameters (number of elements of minimal dominating set, cardinality of cliques with maximality and colourability) of Mobius ladder graphs.

Author Keywords: Mobius ladder graph and minimal dominating set

articleTitle: Windingless Transformer for High Voltage Measurement Using Piezoelectricity
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Piezoelectric potential transformer (PZPT) is a device which can be used to converts voltage from one level to another level. This paper consist of principle of converting voltage with the help of piezoelectric and inverse piezoelectric effect. Instrument transformer are used for measurement and protection purpose in power system. However the bulk size of conventional potential transformer (PT) because of winding inside increases losses in the PT and hence reduces efficiency. Over the drawbacks of conventional PT, the design of piezoelectric based potential transformer are best suited on the basis of efficiency and economic point of view. Piezoelectric potential transformer are special type of transformer works on piezoelectric principle, which transforms high voltage electrical stress firstly into mechanical energy and then return back into electrical energy by direct piezoelectric effect. The conversion of energy and waveform of stepped-down voltage by using piezoelectric potential transformer are necessary to meet optimal working performance of the resonance frequency. This will distinguished the piezoelectric PT from more commonly used copper winding transformers which uses magnetic flux as a medium.

articleTitle: Classification of Human Cancer Diseases Gene Expression Profiles using Genetic Algorithm by Integrating Protein Protein Interactions Along with Gene Expression Profiles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The classifications of different cancer types are most important in cancer diagnosis. The several researches are employed to diagnosis the cancer disease. In the existing research work, the classification of cancer disease is performed based on gene expression data. And it is initially presented Information Gain (IG) for Feature selection and Genetic Algorithm (GA) is used for feature reduction to remove the irrelevant features and noise data present in the given data set. Iteratively the Genetic Algorithm (GA) is classified the types of human cancer. The existing approach has some limitation to classify the cancer disease such as high computation time and required large amount of computational resource. In order to overcome this limitation, the integrated gene expression data with Protein- Protein interaction (IGEPPIN) is proposed for predicting cancer disease by prioritizing disease candidate proteins to rank each protein. In this approach initially find the beginning proteins of human and constructed the PPIN of seed proteins from human PPI data. Second, combine the function similarity of the gene expression profiles and protein to protein interactions confidence for calculating weight of each interacting protein for classification of human cancer disease. Subsequently, measure the disease relevance score for each protein by adding the interaction confidence, functional similarity of its neighbours. Finally calculated the weight of proteins in the specific disease and rank them based on descending order of their scores. The proposed system is estimated based on classification Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F- Measure and Specificity.

articleTitle: IOT Based Smart Community Monitoring Platform for Custom Designed Smart Homes
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The world especially homes are getting smarter on a daily basis, by the arrival of the Internet of Things (IoT). As man is a social being the smart homes must not be standing alone, they must collaborate each other to build a smart community. It is a network of smart homes in a local geography. The smart community acts as an intermediate between smart homes and smart cities. Various papers propose smart community architecture where all homes in it are having the same functionality. But that is not the case in the real-world scenario. In a society, various homes will need various functionalities. Each home will have to monitor different parameters using different sensors and have to provide different responses and services accordingly. This paper presents a monitoring platform for a smart community, of which there are three custom-designed smart homes having different functionalities. The data is sent to community server via MQTT protocol. The data received at the server is saved in a database and is displayed in a webpage in the server. The monitoring platform was successfully implemented and was found functioning well.

articleTitle: Analysis of MMD Labeling On Benes Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A graph G with n vertices is said to have modular multiplicative divisor (MMD) labeling if there exist a bijection f from vertices of G to the set of all natural numbers from 1 to n and for all uve∈ E(G) the edge labels as f(u)f(v)(mod n) such that n divides the sum of all edge labels of G. This paper aim to analyse the roll of MMD labeling in the context of a cyclic decomposition of Benes network.

articleTitle: Consumer Perception towards Consumer Ethnocentrism
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Globalization has brought opportunities for the countries all over the world. Even in India, many imported products are being sold and Indian products are also being exported throughout the world. In today's scenario the Indian customers are having great access to foreign goods and the Indian manufacturers are having competition from foreign products. The rationale behind the study is to analyse the perception of consumer towards home country products and comprehend towards the quality of product and also to analyse the buying habit of domestic products and foreign products by the undergraduates and postgraduates students. The study was done by collecting responses from 150 student consumers studying in private university. The data was analysed through statistical tools such as descriptive analysis, Friedman test, and Regression. The study reveals a positive relationship between the Quality Consciousness and three other factors viz. home country affinity, Pseudopatriotism and the image of Home Country. The home country affinity played a major role in predicting the consumer ethnocentrism.

articleTitle: Large Step-up DC-DC Converter Integrating Voltage Extension Unit and Coupled Inductor for Fuel Cell Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This work introduces `Large step-up DC-DC converter integrating voltage extension unit and coupled inductor for fuel cell application'. The presented converter topology furnishes large power conversion ratio by simply utilizing coupled inductor and voltage extension unit. The presented converter is provided with an interesting provision i.e The number of extensions can be customized to get required duty ratio. The induced voltage on secondary side is rectified by using voltage extension unit so, high voltage transformation ratio can be obtained easily. The utilization of low RDS(on) MOSFET switch is the another advantage, which significantly reduces conduction losses. The operating principle and design principle of the converter are discussed in detail. The MATLAB simulation results for 30V/380V, 500W large step-up DC-DC converter are provided to verify the virtue of the presented converter.

articleTitle: Electronic Device Games: An Implication on Academic Performance of Students in CST
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: There are numerous claim that playing electronic device game may be beneficial for education purpose or just the reverse. However the academic research done in order to check whether or not disclosure of students playing such games which influences the academic performance in Bhutan has been very limited till date. This paper explores the connection of the college students between gaming density and their academic achievements where variables used are measured by the amount of the time students invest their time in playing games and another as measured by their semester examination marks respectively. Using a sample of 180 students in CST (College of Science and Technology), comparative analysis between gaming density and academic performance for students were carried out. The results show that examination marks are negatively reflected with frequent garners than those who never play games. Frequent gamers achieve lower marks compared to students who play games less frequently. This paper intents to address the student of CST for proper management of time during their stay at college in future if they are gamers.

articleTitle: Text Hiding with Binary Indexing of Characters Using Customized PRNG and Pixel Matching Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for improving the hiding capacity using binary indexing of characters in spatial domain steganography. Customized Pseudo Random Number Generation (PRNG) is applied to ensure high security for the text hidden in a color image. Every character in a defined character set is assigned with a binary value which is not same for all bit planes. After the generation of binary numbers for the characters, the series of binary values are shuffled through customized PRNG algorithm. For embedding the shuffled binary data, plus or minus modification made among the pixels. Very less number of binary ones are present in the binary value list assigned to the list of characters in the character set. This consumes less number of pixels in the image for modification. Binary indexing of characters and customized PRNG algorithm creates high security for the text hidden in the image. Experimental results produce better Peak Signal Noise Ratio(PSNR) with high visual quality of stego images.

articleTitle: Study on the Control of Underwater Plant Based On CMAC-PID and GA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Against a variety of uncertainties and nonlinearities of the underwater plant motion control, this paper proposed a control method of underwater test plant based on CMAC-PID and GA algorithm. This approach combined the advantages of both CMAC neural network feedforward control and PID feedback control to form a parallel control structure, in which PID parameters were optimized via genetic algorithm. The simulation results showed that the genetic algorithm can effectively improve the setting process of PID parameters. Meanwhile, the CMAC-PID combination control has good dynamic characteristics and steady-state accuracy, which, to some extent, can be used for reference to the motion control of underwater test plant.

articleTitle: Framework for advanced weather forecasting technique using DMaaS in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Due to the technology growth the volume of the data are become higher in every Data mining scenario. In this paper we proposed the framework for weather forecasting; here also we have some challenges. To overcome the challenges here we proudly introduce the new technique called DMaaS (Data Mining as a Service). In one sentence, DMaaS is the integration of the Data mining concept into the Cloud computing. Here we proposed DMaaS framework for forecasting the weather. For forecasting the weather, we used the data mining prediction concept. DMaaS is not only for prediction, it is applicable for all the Data Mining concepts. This new technique is overcome many challenges and issues. In below section we saw about the technique in detail.

articleTitle: Intuitionistic Fuzzy C-Means Clustering Using Rough set for MRI Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Medical image segmentation needs higher segmentation accuracy due to the occurrence of noises in the images. Fuzzy sets theories are able to handle the vagueness and uncertainty through membership functions in image segmentation. Rough sets theory (RST) is to deal with uncertainty and incompleteness. It focuses on the feature selection based on classification. In real applications, it may be impossible to obtain complete information of a given pattern set due to artifacts. Uncertain information will cause lacking of information for a pattern set in various recognition and classification algorithms. This paper proposes a method to segment the magnetic resonance images with and without noises powerfully. The proposed method uses the intuitionistic fuzzy c-means algorithm for segmenting cerebro spinal fluid (CSF), white matter (WM) and gray matter (GM) tissues in the MRI. Intuitionistic fuzzy image representations are done by using non-membership value, hesitation along with the membership value for the MR image. The membership value and nonmembership value have been obtained using fuzzy trapezoidal membership and fuzzy complement function respectively. Further, intuitionistic fuzzy roughness measures and fuzzy c-means clustering determines the initial cluster centroids by considering lower and upper approximation and updates the euclidean distance between the pixels. The proposed method have been implemented and analyzed with performance metrics for the synthetic and real MR images. Experimental results reveal a superior degree of segmentation on both synthetic and real MR images compared to existing methods.

articleTitle: PIDF Control of the Bidirectional Non-Isolated MIC for Hybrid Energy Storage System of the Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A PIDF controller is designed for the control of a bidirectional non-isolated multi-input DC-DC converter as suggested by Akar et al. for the hybrid energy storage systems of the electric vehicle. The H-ESS discharge is mediated by a three switch control and the charge by a single switch, and the waveforms were analyzed with battery source and a fuel cell. Small signal averaging was performed to develop the state model of the MIC and the transfer function for control of battery current and output voltage were derived. For a setting time of ~10msec and an overshoot of less than 5%, we have found that the PIDF controller performs better in comparison to the PI counterpart.

articleTitle: Robust Multimodal Handvein and Palmprint Based Verification System in the Presence of Salt and Pepper Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Noise is a random signal that usually arises during electronic transmission, preprocessing, acquisition, faulty storage that distorts the original information of the image. Image can be deteriorated by various kinds of noises. In our work, we are proposing both the unimodal and multimodal biometric verification system adopting hand-based traits and we are also analyzing the robustness of the deployed system by adding salt and pepper noise that takes either maximum or minimum grey values. The experimentation is performed on multimodal preclassification and post classification techniques and the verification results are tabulated for standard threshold values at 0.01%, 0.1 %, 1 %.

articleTitle: Study of Properties of Attraction of Water with the Hydrophobic Surfaces
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper, characteristics of water with the hydrophobic surfaces has been studied. According to the present scenario, when water deals with any surface then adhesive force acts between that surface and water. If adhesive force is strong then, water is absorbed by the surface but if adhesive force is weak then water cannot be absorbed by the surface and these types of surfaces are called hydrophobic surfaces. It has been observed that when some water drops fall on a hydrophobic surface and if the surface is upside down then some droplets fall down but few of them remain stick to the surface for a long time. Many explanations have been given in this regard but due to weak adhesive force, all the explanations seem to be incomplete as weak adhesive force may not result in the stickiness of the water droplet with the surface for a long time. Here, it has been analyzed that along with the adhesive force, a special type of cohesive force also acting there. Thus, due to the presence of adhesive force and this minor cohesive force, water drop remain stick to the hydrophobic surface. Without this special cohesive force, water droplets either slide or fall down from the hydrophobic surface.

articleTitle: Analysis of Newly Developed Third Harmonic Injection Mothod with Ovpmw Method for a PV System Connected Through 3-Level Diode Clamped Inverter to an Induction Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper clarifies a relative investigation of tweak strategies for 3 level NPC Voltage Source Inverter for a heap associated Photo Voltaic (PV) framework. The examination is completed on two sorts of adjustment systems utilized as a part of three level MLI, viz. Recently grew third harmonic injection technique and ovpmw adjustment. The motivation behind the review is to dangerously break down and arrange the issues related with existing DCMLI utilized. It is watched that the three level Diode Clamped Multilevel Inverter (DCMLI) experiences limit beat width and does-interface capacitor voltage unbalancing, when associated with the most astounding appraised PV framework. Also, this issue results in wasteful execution of DCMLI, accordingly aggravating the power quality. The examination likewise accentuates the current balance procedures, albeit well known for inverters however neglecting to meet the present prerequisites when associated with MLI. The perception is checked by planning and actualizing the model in MATLAB/Simulink and appropriate outcomes are shown.

articleTitle: A Novel Bypass Routing Algorithm for Wired or Wireless Using WCF and RCF
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Wired and wireless communication plays a significant role in our life. In order to compensate the failure of wired network; wireless network must provide alternative communication. To achieve quick communication recovery in the disaster area, we use NeCo system (network cooperation). In our existing system which is achieved by using single hop wireless bypass routes. When the wired communications for leaf nodes get disrupted, surviving relay packets of leaf nodes transfer and receive through wireless bypass routes. To overcome the limitation in the above method, we use WCF and RCF protocols in order to reduce the latency and load balance to achieve quick communication.

articleTitle: Bridgeless Boost AC to DC Converter with Achievement of Better Power Factor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A large no of application uses non-linear devices which affect the power factor of the system and introduces harmonics in the power system. The various techniques are used to reduce the harmonics and improvement of power factor in the power system. In this paper, presents the one of the new technique are used to control the power factor and reduce the harmonics by using bridgeless boost ac to dc converter. This converter is operating in continuous conduction mode (CCM). The total harmonic distortion is reduced and boost dc output voltage is presented in the simulation.

articleTitle: Fire Event Detection from Video and Estimation of Risk for Safety of Human and Resources
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: invertors; learning (artificial intelligence); Internet; DC-DC power convertors; feature extraction; photovoltaic power systems; power grids; power generation control; pattern classification; cryptography.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of MIMO Antenna for WLAN Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents a two component multiple input multiple output antenna for wireless local area network (WLAN) applications. The design process is described in a systematic manner, in the beginning, single square patch with square shaped split ring slot is established. Subsequently the two element MIMO antenna is designed. The elements are placed opposite side to each other. The reduction of mutual coupling between the antenna elements is accomplished by defect introduced on the ground plane. The proposed single-element and two-element antenna operated at 5.8GHz. The FR4 substrate is used with the 0.8mm thickness. The substrate width and length is 34.485mm and 42.837mm respectively. The size of the patch is 9mm x 9mm. The functional parameter namely, S parameter, radiation pattern and ECC of the proposed MIMO antenna, are investigated. The proposed antenna ECC is less than 0.0001.

articleTitle: Analysing the Pattern Discovery for Human Interaction using Semantic Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In recent days, human interaction is carried out through the social media via Facebook, messenger, etc. As the social media are derived for the interaction of peoples in all parts of the world and their conversation can be text, audio, video, etc. In general, communication can be established based on the plain text document only. During the human interaction, lack of prediction and extracting the information exists. To overcome the problem, propose a TEX classification algorithm to classify the interaction based on positive/negative subject to the interaction of the people. SEM approach is proposed to relate the expression based on text and to provide proper pattern discovery for the interaction. In the performance analysis, accuracy is taken into account to evaluate the efficiency of the proposed algorithm based on positive/negative constraints with the existing one.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of Grid Considering the Impact of Wind Energy
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Electric energy the driving force for today's world economy and became a daily need for the population in the world. The demand goes on increasing drastically and it became a problem to satisfy such huge demands. Moreover, the conventional fuels for the electricity generation such as coal, natural gas, etc are not abundant and going to exhaust in coming days [1]. The environmental impact by the conventional methods concerns to have an alternative eco-friendly method to avoid nature disruption such as global warming etc. Wind energy, which is naturally available and renewable source, stands as the best alternative. Upon assessment, wind power generation is considered as an inconsistent and intermittent source. The fluctuation of the wind and the location of the wind farm matters plays a key role in the power output value. The output characteristics are completely different compared to the conventional prime movers. In this, Capacity Outage Probability Table (COPT) is a simple and convenient approach for conventional reliability assessment [2]. This is generally accepted as reliable approach for the adequacy assessment. We just concern about no derated states for the generators in the evaluation.

articleTitle: A Cuk Converter Based Fault Detection and Correction Topology for BLDC Drives in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Growing concern about the environment and fuel paucity leads to an increased usage of electric vehicles. Electric vehicles are those which functions based on electric drives. Due to the immense benefits of brushless dc motors, they replace induction motors in electric vehicles. A system is supposed to be consistent if it can manage with fault and functions perfectly as earlier in case of any faulty events. There are primarily two sorts of faults that happen across the switches in a control circuit, namely short circuit fault and open circuit fault. In this paper, a novel circuitry for fault recognition and rectification through the technique of employing redundant legs for both the front end converter and the full bridge inverter is presented. Compared to the contemporary methods, the proposed circuitry helps in safe detachment and reconfiguration of switches that undergoes any of the above stated faults. A protection circuit integrated in the topology helps in overvoltage and overcurrent protection. Usage of cuk converter as a front end converter makes the anticipated topology more proficient as it can operate in both the buck and boost modes, which is very vital in case of electric vehicles. This makes the topology more compatible to the applications. The simulation outcomes substantiate the consistency and viability of the anticipated topology.

articleTitle: Closed Loop Control of Multi Input DC to DC Converter for DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Integration of renewable energy sources to DC grid is a challenging task. If several individual sources are connected to the grid through power electronic converters, circuit complexity is more and power management is complex. This led to the introduction of multi input dc to dc converter. In this paper, three sources, which are renewable energy sources, are connected to a dc micro grid using a multi input dc to dc converter. The sources inject power to the grid based on the power demanded by the load at a constant dc grid voltage. The closed loop simulation of the multi input dc to dc converter is done on Matlab/Simulink Platform. The converter is tested for load regulation. Power management is done by Fuzzy Logic Controller.

Author Keywords: power management of dc to dc converter

articleTitle: Stress Diagonisis Using EMG Signals
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Stress diagnosis is a common factor used for monitoring patient's health. In the current generation, stress diagnosis is an important factor to identify certain behavioral pattern of a person. Physical stress is easily identified but then mental stress is not predictable at ease. On a specific base, mental stress for patients with cerebral palsy is difficult to diagnose. For this condition, the EMG signals are used. The patients are monitored with certain criteria level for which neural networks are implemented with its designing algorithm for identifying the diagnostic work by the equipment itself instead of doctor monitoring.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of Developing Chat Application in Bhutan
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The paper explores the need of development of chat application in Bhutan. Taking a sample size of 371 population of Bhutan, a traditional survey and interview were conducted in major towns and city of Bhutan. The results revealed that 74% of the Bhutanese people were willing to use chat application if ever developed in our country. Moreover, the survey also revealed the existence of 64% population using smart phone and chat application in Bhutan. Among 64% of users, dominant percent of users felt comfortable to use chat application rather than texting or calling via phones. The survey analysis supports a feasible and potential chat application market in Bhutan. The paper further targets future Bhutanese chat developer in developing relevant chatting applications.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Squeezed Restoration using p-Cycle together with Minimum Power Consumption in Elastic Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Due to flexible bandwidth structure, affected services can be partially restored in elastic optical networks (EONs). Bandwidth Squeezed restoration (BSR) approach maximizes restoration level with limited frequency slots (FSs) in each span. However, the power consumption is one of the great challenges in EONs. EONs with flexible bandwidth and spectrally efficient, are also major contributors in the power consumption. There is extremely large amount of data transmission in the network since network failure causes huge data loss. In order to achieve this high reliability requirement, network architectures are laid down with a large number of redundant resources taking into account the resource requirement for backup protection. These redundant resources are also major contributors to the power consumption. Shortest path routing (SPR) is generally considered in power saving strategies. This paper focuses on BSR using preconfigured cycles (p-cycles) in EONs with power conscious routing (PCR) against single link failure. An integer linear programming (ILP) model has been formulated to minimize power consumption. Minimization of power consumption is based on PCR by maximizing number of idle network resources into sleep mode. Numerical results indicate that the PCR is more power efficient than SPR during low traffic but at the cost of additional frequency slots (FSs). BSR provide the maximum restoration level with available FSs in each span after the occurrence of failure. In addition, it is seen that as the traffic increases, the power consumption saturates.

articleTitle: Social Impact of Demonetization in South India: A Fuzzy Classification Approach using Equivalence Relations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The Fuzzy set theory provides a way for representing uncertainties. All uncertainty is unspoken to follow the characteristics of random uncertainty. This paper classifies the region with the impact of demonetization in south India using survey data collected from the sample respondents of Karnataka, Kerala, Odisha, Telangana, Andhra and Tamil Nadu states. A procedure is created to classify the regions according to the equivalence relations of fuzzy set theory across the southern states and Odisha, public opinion is evenly poised on the demonetization. The consideration of the broader objectives of the demonetization is large encouraging. The opinions are divided into various groups to find whether its arrangement could have been better or not. The results presented here are for the classification of regions based on their interest.

articleTitle: Terminal State Constrained Proportional Navigation Law for Lunar Soft Landing Mission
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: With regards to a typical lunar soft landing guidance formulation, it is required to reach the desired position with terminal velocity and orientation constraints. For the terminal phase of lunar powered descent, an existing proportional navigation law developed for missile guidance is modified. Presently in the algorithm, at the beginning of each guidance cycle, a normal acceleration perpendicular to the instantaneous missile-target line-of-sight is computed. The design augmentation proposed in this paper for lunar landing, introduces a polynomial acceleration term along the line-of-sight direction in addition to the existing normal acceleration which would then ensure terminal velocity requirements. It also has the capability to meet zero line-of-sight angles at the end of trajectory maneuver. Simulation results indicate that the developed methodology can be successfully utilized in lunar landing scenarios, especially in the terminal phases where the Lander orientation has to be vertical at the end.

articleTitle: Development of Learning Automaton based Maximum Power Point Tracking Algorithm for Solar PV System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The main objective of this paper is to introduce the concept of Learning Automata (LA) algorithm and its adaptability for the development of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) controller for solar PV system. MPPT algorithm using LA is proposed and the development of LA as MPPT is explained in detail. The proposed MPPT receives the temperature and irradiation as input and the MPPT output is the duty cycle. The LA MPPT is initially trained for various ranges of temperature and irradiation levels in offline. The trained controller is implemented online and tested for various conditions through simulation using MATLAB. The performance proposed LA MPPT is analyzed by comparing the results with P&O MPPT.

articleTitle: Voltage Swell Minimization by Solar Photovoltaic Fed Impedance-Source Inverter Based DVR
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Impedance or Z-Source inverter is an emerging power converter topology that has been used as a step-up and step-down converter in a single unit. This paper presents a solar photovoltaic fed impedance or Z-source inverter (ZSI) based Dynamic Voltage Restorer (DVR) for the alleviation of destructive voltage swells in a power distribution system. This article also proposed a hybrid technique for optimum maximum power point tracking (MPPT). The proposed hybrid technique is the combination of the perturbation and observation (P&O) technique and the incremental conductance (InC) technique. The design, modeling and simulation of the proposed PV-ZSI-DVR are implemented in MATLAB/SIMULINK for mitigation of voltage swell and the obtained results are compared with traditional SPV fed voltage source inverter (VSI) and current source inverter (CSI) based DVRs.

articleTitle: A Study of KVP Approach on Some Transportation Models
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper Vogel's Approximation Method and Least Cost Method for Transportation Problem were investigated to obtain the solution at a faster rate using Key-Value Pair approach. Computation experiments were carried out to investigate the effectiveness of Key-Value pair over 1900 problem instances for Vogel's Approximation Method and Least Cost Method each. It was seen that Key-Value pair greatly enhanced the rate of solving for both methods over traditional coding approach. Time comparison is shown for square balanced transportation problems.

articleTitle: Enhanced simulation infrastructure for DFT ATPG simulations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In the high demand of electronics such as mobile, tablets there is increase in the demand for high speed, good battery life and high storage. As it is common notion that power and speed always form inverse relation thus compromising on one factor is acceptable to customers. But area that is storage is a demanding factor and in order to achieve such high storage, Technology is shrinking down drastically (currently at 7nm) and expected to go even lower. With this shrinking of technology the need for detecting manufacturing defects becomes important and thus DFT architecture and regress pattern simulations become necessary factor.
