The applied voltage that is considered here is AC sinusoidal voltage. Results obtained improves the understanding on behaviour of partial discharge under applied voltage; also assist in insulation diagnostics.

articleTitle: A Novel Single switch Transformerless Buck-Boost Converter with Non inverting Output
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A novel buck-boost converter with non inverting output voltage is proposed in this study. The proposed converter is non isolated and also employs single switch. The voltage gain of the proposed converter is thrice compared to a traditional buck- boost and CUK converter. Usage of single switch reduces the implementation as well as switching power loss. Also converter requires a simple control circuitry.

articleTitle: Digital notice board using Smart Phones- Speech Recognition Voice command
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Now a days notice board has become an important thing in institutes/organization or public places like railway stations, bus stands and hospitals. But to use the paper notices stacked on a notice board is a time taking and expensive process and there is wastage lot of time, paper and labour. The notice board is used to display the information in an effective way to the people, but to update the messages instantly is not easy on the notice board. In this paper we have proposed and implemented an advanced Hi-Tech wireless Notice Board. An Android application of smart phones or tablet which is connected to Bluetooth (HC-05) can be used to display the latest information by enhancing the system. A low cost programmed microcontroller (arduino uno) is used at the receiver to receive and display messages in the LCD display. Instead of sticking notices manually on a notice board the authorized user can speak and the verbalized voice is sent through a Bluetooth and displayed on the LCD screen. In this project we are using a flexible and most successful speech recognize technique called as Hidden Markov Model(HMM) to recognize the speech for voice and then that recognized sampled speech voice are processed identified as a verbalized text done by connecting to a google's server via internet. And the speech is inputted from a microphone and only an English message has taken as an input for our application and it is online speech to text conversion.

articleTitle: Higher Order Sliding Mode Control and Performance Evaluation of DC Motor Under Parameter Variations
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Design of robust controller for DC motor under parameter variations is a challenging task. Sliding Mode Control technique is a widely used robust controller design methodology that takes care of parameter variations. The Sliding Mode Control is used to constrain the system trajectories to evolve onto the sliding surface. This paper examine the performance evaluation of armature controlled DC motor under considering uncertainties using first order and Second Order Sliding Mode Control. The first order sliding mode was designed by using unit vector approach. The two control algorithms twisting and super twisting of second order sliding mode was implemented in simulation in MATLAB environment.

articleTitle: Converters for HVDC Transmission for Offshore Wind Farms: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Unrestricted use of conventional sources of energy has led to over extraction and depletion in these resources. To continue with the economic, technological and industrial development inspires the search for non-traditional energy sources like the solar, tidal, wind, geological i.e. geothermal energy sources, etc. Extraction of energy from these resources is based on factors like site, cost of installation, cost of production, transmission of power, etc. Wind energy source is one of the most promising and mature sources amongst the non traditional sources of energy. Particularly, offshore wind farms are more suitable for large scale production. However, long distances transmission of power is a matter of concern. High Voltage Alternating Current (HVAC) or High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems can be used for transmission of bulk power over long distances. This paper gives a summary of existing HVAC and HVDC systems. Also, it reviews various converter topologies used in HVDC transmission systems. It also discusses in detail MMC topology for HVDC transmission.

articleTitle: Non Invasive Blood Glucose Detection along with an Assistive Diabetes Monitoring App
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A Diabetes monitoring method has been developed using the blood glucose measurement made non-invasively. Glucose is the prime factor which is considered for the diagnosis of Diabetes mellitus. The common method for determining the glucose content in blood involves hand pricking by taking the blood samples. Regular pricking can cause pain and inconvenience which can even lead to calluses on the fingers and poor blood flow. Non-invasive technique is the recent advancement which does not involve drawing of any human interstitial fluids. The paper involves the design of a noninvasive glucose level detector using the Near Infrared (NIR) Spectroscopy concept and a smart device. The signals send through the fingertip will be absorbed based on vibrational movements. The result is obtained as voltage variations. The data thus obtained is then interfaced to an android device via Bluetooth to a monitoring android application which assist in keeping track of the glucose level.

articleTitle: AES Parallel Implementation on a Homogeneous Multi-Core Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The new technology paradigm of the Industrial Internet revolution, namely, the Internet of Things have been considered one of the most important technology for the near future, that has seen vast and rapid leaps in the past few years. The global network, which connects machines and devices, interacting to provide us with an enhanced sense of connectivity has overwhelmed the industries and researchers have been working endlessly to enhance the working of these networks. In our paper we analyze the security aspects of the communication between the nodes that makes it all possible. We evaluate the working of the Encryption algorithms that controls the authentication procedure in the sensor network using the microcontrollers. The Advanced Encryption Standard has been rightly suggested as the most suitable symmetric cipher for wireless sensing network applications. However, when AES is implemented it would rather be slow and can consume relatively significant amount of time to run to completion. Our aim in this research is to increase the speed processing of AES encryption algorithm using the parallel and sequential mechanism and comparing the performance result between them. This work revolves around working with the key sizes of 192 which has around 90% enhancement and in 256 key size an enhancement of 89% has been established. Our implementation is believed to be the first proposed work for deploying AES in a homogenous multicore microcontroller.

articleTitle: Evaluation and Minimization of Total Harmonic Distortion in Two Level Voltage-Source Inverter Fed Induction Motor Drives
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper attempts to evaluate the ideal PWM waveforms over the complete modulation range based on the least motor line current distortion (\pmbITHD) for a two level inverter operated at low pulse number (P) due to switching loss constrain. Two types of pole voltage waveforms for P=\pmb5 is considered, namely typeA and typeB. Further, each type of PWM waveform produces two sets of solution, labeled as solution set-A and solution set-B. An optimal PWM based on the combination of both types of waveforms are evaluated and compared with the traditional SHE PWM technique. A complete Simulink model is developed to validate and confirm the theoretical outcomes for a two level inverter driving a 2.2kW squirrel cage induction motor. The results show a significantly improved performance of the proposed PWM method over SHE PWM in terms of total harmonic distortion (THD%) of line voltage for modulationindexabove0.6.

articleTitle: Realization of High Speed Low Power MCC Adder using Dynamic CMOS Transistors
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Using multioutput domino CMOS logic, a cost effective implementation of Manchester carry chain (MCC) adder for 8-bit is designed in this paper. From this adder carries are generated parallelly employing two main carry chains of 4-bit. The suggested 8-bit adder module comprise confined length of carry chain. As a result of this ability, it is applied to realize broader adders and as well it guides to betterments in functioning rate equated to the related adders established upon the classical 4-bit MCC adder module.

articleTitle: Mars Entry Phase Trajectory Tracking Controller using Dynamic Inversion
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Typical Mars Lander mission involves entry phase, parachute descent and the terminal powered descent. Reference trajectory for the entry phase will be planned on ground considering the initial and target states along with satisfying the aerodynamic constraints. This paper proposes to use a controller designed on the basis of Dynamic Inversion for tracking the reference state trajectory along with a novel strategy to reduce cross-range error by partial bank angle control. Nominal two-dimensional trajectories are planned with lift and drag as the control parameters which inadvertently points out to required angle-of-attack and zero bank angle. Under perturbations in initial states, reference state trajectory will be tracked through dynamic inversion. New control solution would finally come out in terms of new angle-of-attack and bank angle manoeuvres. Through considering cross-range and cross velocities as additional states, bank angle solution of one axis is imposed onto the other alternatively at regular intervals thus reducing the cross-range error. The resultant tracking law has been observed to track even large dispersions especially in initial velocity and even under constraints in aerodynamic angles.

articleTitle: Multi Level Inverter with Reduced Number of Switches for Drives
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Multi Level Inverter generates output voltage with very low harmonic distortion. This is achieved by providing multiple steps in the output voltage. They are used for high power applications with improved power quality. Circuit complexity is a major issue in most of the conventional topologies of Multi Level Inverters. As the number of levels increases, the no of switches will increase and the switching scheme will be more complicated. In this paper, a modified reduced switch inverter topology with unequal switching scheme is used to drive a single phase induction motor load. Simulation and result analysis of this 11 level MLI is carried out using PSIM software and hardware implementation is carried out to evaluate the performance to prove the effectiveness of the MLI.

articleTitle: Analysis Modelling & Simulation of VSC based D-Statcom for Reactive VAR Compensation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: objective of this paper is to compensate the reactive power in transmission line using proposed PI control technique in the D-statcom. D-Statcom is basically shunt compensator device used for lagging and leading reactive power compensation. Here D-statcom in two level inverter. In this paper design and implementation of D-statcom VSC based are done and compared the result under different loading condition with controller and without controller. The control technique used for VSC is SPWM. Now a days FACTS devices are very useful for the compensation and control of reactive power in transmission and distribution power system network. This will improve the stability of system under faulty condition and under varying condition so that problem of Ferranti effect during low load condition and low voltage at the terminal end during high load condition can be mitigate using proper FACTS devices and improved control technique in the compensating devices.

articleTitle: Processing Retinal Images to Discover Diseases
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The retina of a human eye consists of billion of photosensitive cells (rods and cones) and alternative nerve cells that acquire and arrange visual information. The retina of a human eye is a thin tissue layer on the inside back wall of your eye. Three of the most common retinal diseases are Diabetic Retinopathy, Glaucoma, and Cataract. The world is presently experiencing an epidemic of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR). Current predictions draw an estimation of doubling of the number affected from the current 170 million to an estimated 367 million by 2030. We propose a system wherein we extract blood vessels of the retina to detect eye diseases. Manually extracting the blood vessels of the human retina is a time-consuming task, and thus an automation of this process results in easy implementation of the work. This paper aims to design and consequently implement deep convolutional neural networks to identify the presence of an exudate, and thereby classify it into Diabetic Retinopathy, Glaucoma, and/or Cataract.

articleTitle: Electric Motors and Rotor Position Detection Techniques of Integrated Starter Alternator for HEV: A Review
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The Aim of Faster Adoption and Manufacturing (FAME) of Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) is to save Rs. 60,000 Cr annually in Oil's import bill by 2020. To fulfill this aim and to increase the use of HEV, researchers are more focused on development of an efficient and economically stable HEV. Integrated Starter Alternator (ISA) which performs the functions of both starter as well as alternator is developed helping to reduce cost and weight of the HEV. However, to choose a proper electric machine and control strategy for smooth operation of HEV is the matter of concern. This paper gives an overview of existing AC machines used in HEV. Also, it reviews various control techniques used for smooth running of ISA for HEV application.

articleTitle: Comparison between Conventional Fly-back and Interleaved Fly-back Converter for Standalone PV Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Now a days power generation from solar (PV) has increased more interest due to its various advantages. Some of these are, it generate green and clean energy and hence it does not impact on the environmental nature. It is inconvenient to use PV system, only because its conversion efficiency is low. Thus, this paper presents analysis of inverter for standalone PV applications based on modified integrated interleaved Fly-back converter topology in order to increase the conversion efficiency. Advantages of interleaved Fly-back converter over the conventional Fly-back converter is discussed in this paper. The converter to be used for high power applications, this is the main advantage of interleaving of Fly-back stages.

articleTitle: Impact of Modulation Techniques for Hybrid-WDM Based FSO
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Free space optical communication (FSO) provides high data rate by allowing light passed through the atmosphere. It is very effective and efficient technology for wireless communication. This emerging field basically uses invisible beams of light such as ultraviolet, infrared, etc. This work exclusively deals with the designing of hybrid WDM based FSO system using the simulation software Opti-System 7.0 with Minimum-Shift Keying and Differential-phase-shift keying. Further their study has been made as to which modulation techniques provides better means of communication. The normal rain weakening is assessed from rain power information which are gathered for a period for six months. The concert of the future system is evaluated in terms of Bit Error Rate, Q-factor, and Receiver Sensitivity are examined with respect to link distance for using rain attenuation 20.5dBm. The transmission wavelength and data rate is 1550nm and 2.5Gbps considered for investigation.

articleTitle: A Novel LS-LMMSE Channel Parameter Tuning Approach using Particle Swarm Optimization in MIMO-OFDM
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The performance of Multi Input Multi Output-Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing system solely depends on the estimate of the channel. Least square (LS) and least minimum mean squared error (LMMSE) channel estimation techniques are widely used for channel estimation. Least square estimate suffers from inherent additive Gaussian noise and Inter Carrier Interference and least minimum mean squared error estimate had higher computational complexity. Due to multi antennas and channel delays the performance of channel estimation algorithm degrades. For large MIMO systems channel coefficients increases and the problem becomes multimodal. Particle swarm optimization has capability to solve problems when numbers of variables are more. In this paper, parameters of least square estimate & least minimum mean squared error estimate are efficiently used for tuning particle swarm initial parameters to optimize the performance of \pmb2x\pmb2 MIMO system. The minimum bit error rate at signal to noise ratio from LS estimate & LMSSE estimate is used as a target for swarm particles for finding optimized channel matrix. Results showed that the swarm was able to lower the bit error rate at all signal to noise ratios during multiple runs.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach of Power Generation from Fitness Equipment's
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: As strength usage across the world continues to upward push, there's a sturdy need to expand new methods for energy conservation and energy technology, especially procedures which have much less environmental impacts. Although human strength is not ideal in phrases of life cycle costs there are promising application regions for human electricity in rising regions wherein electric strength is either now not available or not lower priced. There is also untapped potential for harnessing human electricity at maximum fitness centers. This paper makes a speciality of the feasibility of shooting this electricity at health facilities especially, whilst we training session on preferred exercising system inside the gym, all the kinetic strength we generate is completely wasted on the machine. It's really now not a new concept to transform that kinetic strength into electric energy, but up till recently nothing turned into commercially to be had. This machine without difficulty converts existing equipment into electricity producing machines, so when we step on and start shifting, maximum of our energy generates DC energy. The DC strength is then sent to a battery and then it's far converted to AC the use of an inverter circuit and then used for electric home equipment.

articleTitle: Customer Perception on Online Banking System in Bhutan: A Study on Mobile Banking of Bank of Bhutan
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A descriptive study on customer satisfaction on mBoB (Mobile Bank of Bhutan) service in Bhutan examined the satisfaction level and challenges faced by mBoB users in Bhutan. For this purpose, a primary data was collected with the help of structured questionnaire consisting 28 items. A convenience sampling technique was adopted to select a total of 150 respondents around Bhutan locality. The data gathered were analyzed with the help of descriptive statistics like simple frequency, percentages and mean. The study revealed that factors to ease of use, security, accessibility for 24 hours were statistically significant and has positive effects on customer satisfaction on using mBoB. The study also shows that strong internet is mandatory to access the service as weak internet hampers while accessing the service.

articleTitle: CMOS-DRPTL Adder Topologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: With the revolution in integrated circuits, great emphasis was given on performance and miniaturization. Speed, area and power became the main criterion upon which a VLSI system is measured in terms of its efficiency. In any VLSI system, a full adder is widely component, which also decides the performance criteria of the system. Basically the adder circuit is designed to achieve low power and less delay and by logic gate of the circuit improves the performances. For speed process high logic circuit is implemented and also to have less propagation. In hybrid CMOS design style various adder cells and transistor is used, but in proposed circuit Dual Rail Signal System (DRPTL) is implemented with the load condition and the clock signal to manage the power flow in the circuit and the process is performed in an efficient way in terms of its gate count and thereby on power and speed.

articleTitle: MRAC BasedApproachforStabilization of Single Link InvertedPendulum
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The problem of balancing an inverted pendulum has been a benchmark problem in demonstrating various control design techniques. The principal reasons for it's popularity are its nonlinear and unstable characteristics. In this paper a single link inverted pendulum system has been chosen and adaptive control algorithm has been implemented for stabilization of the system so that pendulum is always maintained erected in its upright (inverted) position. Model Reference Adaptive Control (MRAC) method is implemented using MIT rule. Minimization of cost function is performed and system response has been observed for different adaption gain. After system modeling the whole process is done in MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: A Secure Data Transmission using Modified RSA and Random Pixel Replacement Steganography
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In the modern world, there is a necessity of high security of multimedia data. This secured system should provide confidentiality, authenticity, integrity and non-repudiation in the network. The confidential details transferred through internet are hacked by phishing in an electronic communication world. So information security plays an important role. The Cryptographic algorithms are applied over many applications for secure transmission of data against malignant attacks. Steganography is used to hide their existence. Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) is an asymmetric cryptographic, highly secured algorithm. Since it is complex to compute, different methods are applied to increase the speed of an RSA algorithm. In this paper, a secrete text data is encrypted using RSA with modifications and then it is hidden in cover image using random pixel replacement technique. This paper proposed a method to enhance the security of communication by combining cryptography and steganography methods. The proposed system is more efficient in securing data from unauthorized users.

articleTitle: Shunt Active Filter for Harmonic Compensation Using Fuzzy Logic Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Nowadays nonlinear loads are increasing day by day due to industriliasation. Power quality problems increases due to these nonlinear loads. Major power quality problem is the current harmonics. Shunt active filter (SHAF) is used to reduce the current harmonics. Response and the accuracy of filter depends on the method used for the extraction of reference current. A new topology has been proposed in this this paper to minimize the current harmonics by controlling shunt active filter using fuzzy logic controller (FLC) with instantaneous active and reactive current theory (i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub> and i<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>) within the limit of IEEE Std. 519. Under different supply voltage conditions simulation is done with fuzzy logic controller and synchronous reference frame technique. To analyze the performance of SHAF three phase four wire (3P4W) system is considered. Simulation result shows that Fuzzy controller technique gives the best performance under balanced and unbalanced voltage conditions.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis and Challenges of the Map Reduce Framework in Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this day and age, with increasing requirements to analyze enormous datasets and execute the necessary processing on complex data structures, Big Data Analytics is the proposed solution. The problem currently faced is that large amounts of data produced from heterogeneous sources require analysis and proper storage with the greatest efficiency and low cost. This is where the Map Reduce framework comes handy - it speeds up the processing by providing a consolidated approach to machine learning. In this paper, we shall study the MapReduce algorithm, its requirement, its advantages, its disadvantages along with challenges and their respective solutions.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Chaos Approach for Image Encryption Using CTIC Map
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Image security has observed an outstanding need in lots of applications where the data is to be included from unauthorized get right of access to. This strategy also gives highspeed security by combining a three chaotic map. In this work, we propose a chaos-based image encryption with cubic, tent and ICMIC map. Experimental result demonstrates that original image is autonomous than the scrambled image. The proposed strategy is easy to execute, computationally secure and has high encryption rate.

articleTitle: Comparison of Wireless Network Performance Analysis Tools
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Wireless networks are used in wide proportion. The strength of this network may vary from place to place and it causes various problems in daily routine. For making the situation right there is a need to have an accurate data regarding our network's performance. Even though having this data is a very common practice, there happens a lot of confusion about which wireless network performance analysis tools should be used. This paper includes a study of few of the highly reliable wireless network performance analysis tools available on the internet.

articleTitle: Automatic Building Extraction from VHR Satellite Image
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A satellite image contains natural region such as soil and vegetation and man created regions such as roads and buildings. Among these the precise location and identification of building features is one of the key information sources for urban planning, population estimation, land analysis, and environmental surveying. Previously low resolution satellite images were useful to analyze the features of buildings. Now-a- days due to the advancement of the technologies in the field of remote sensing, high spatial resolution imagery becomes available which provides more potential to automatically detect buildings. However, the high resolution image data contain rich information in the spatial domain which does not necessarily increase accuracy of the feature extraction significantly. Therefore, recent advances in the high resolution image processing is focused on the geometrical, spectral, statistical, contextual, and structural information extraction from the image. In this paper a technique to detect and to extract geometric features of the buildings in urban area from very high resolution (VHR) image has been proposed. The geometric features such as area, perimeter, centroid, solidity, convex area, are extracted. In order to analyze the performance of extraction, various edge detection mechanisms such as Sobel, Prewitt, Robert, Canny are implemented using Matlab. The performance analysis shows that canny operator with FCM clustering outperforms compared to conventional edge detection mechanisms.

articleTitle: Multilayered and Dual-Band CB-CPW Fed Wearable Antenna for Healthcare Monitoring Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper introduced the recent SRR loaded proposed conductor backed coplanar wave guide fed wearable antenna is exceptionally essential part for wearable transceiver module for healthcare monitoring. This antenna designed to fine-tune at resonating frequency 2.4GHz and 3.5GHz.this is the one of the on-body narrow band communication ISM and Wi-MAX frequency band. This is SRR loaded antenna; hence it has high gain, bandwidth, and flexible frequency tuning. The simulated results for the magnitude of reflection coefficient are -32dB at 2.4GHz, -25dB at 3.4GHz for non-SRR loaded structure, -16dB at 2.37GHz and -24dB at 3.57GHz for SRR loaded antenna respectively. The antenna required characteristic like such as far-field configuration, magnitude of reflection coefficient, VSWR and gain of the proposed antenna is presented.

articleTitle: Dynamic Fuzzy Parser to Parse English Sentence Using POS Tagger and Fuzzy Max-Min Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Natural Language (NL) is an essential part of ourlife. Humans use language for communication. NL is a prevailing tool used by the humans to convey the information. Natural Language Understanding (NLU) is a major challenge in Natural Language Processing (NLP). NLP is a part of Artificial Intelligence (AI). NLP provides a significant tool for communication. It attempts to produces noise free data and conversion of noise to text. NLU is having different levels. This paper presents the issue with respect to one of the level such as syntax analysis. To provide a solution for syntax analysis, dynamic fuzzy parser is designed and implemented to parse the English input sentences. Traditional approach of parsing is enhanced by applying fuzzy logic. This helps to know the syntactic correctness of the sentence. Penns tree bank parts of speech tags are used for the Parts of Speech Tagger (POS). POS tagger assigns the parts of speech tags for the input English sentence. Then these tags of the words are parsed using the grammar rules. Finally the result is displayed to represent the number of words parsed in a sentence with its associated fuzzy membership value. This parser produces Precision value of 1(100%), Recall value of 0.92 (92%) and F-measure value of 0.9583 for the sample of 50 correct and 50 incorrect sentences.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Life of a Battery by Introducing Ultra Capacitor in Armoured Fighting Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Armoured Fighting Vehicle (AFV) is designed for mobility, firepower and protection. AFV is equipped with high energy power pack for its mobility, which needs a starter motor for starting the same. The starter motor demands a heavy inrush current which will leave a stress on the 24V, 400 Ah VRLA battery bank. Ultra Capacitor (UC) is a capacitor with low energy density and high power density which reduces the stress on batteries. After theoretical studies, the UC was integrated in parallel with the battery bank and tested for its performance. This paper will discuss the details of the configuration, testing and results of the performance of the battery with UC.

articleTitle: Hard Decoding Based Design of Regular LDPC using LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: High speed internet access for all is fast becoming a reality. Noise and bit errors affecting a bit stream in a medium makes it necessary to encode the voice data being transmitted over IP networks, thereby allowing reduction in noise at the receiving end and accurately reconstruct the transmitted audio data. This paper proposes a LabViewbased implementation of regular Neal and McKay LDPC codes for audio transmission. It examines 2 case studies of such an implementation for 16 bit and 32 bit LDPC with the message vector 8 bit long in both the cases. Pearson's degree of correlation for these two cases shows a greater value for 32 bit code design as compared to 16 bit design. The authors can safely extrapolate from this result that a design with a sufficiently high number of parity check bits, will make it possible to reconstruct an error free audio representation of the transmitted data.

articleTitle: A Review on Energy Conservation in Manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Energy conservation is indisputably important to all human beings, as we depend on energy for our regular routine in day to day life. Energy supplies are restricted, so we have to find ways to use energy sensibly. Energy saving is a key area of focus in recent time for many organizations and opportunities do exists in any given manufacturing units. In this paper, Different Research papers were studied and analysed. From this, Energy saving techniques and Different technologies related to use energy more efficiently and Emission Reduction are discussed.

articleTitle: Voltage control of PWM-VSI Assisted Standalone Self Excited Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In remote areas, to produce electricity from wind energy Self Excited Induction Generators (SEIG) are extensively used. This paper presents simulation and experimental results of a Stand Alone SEIG and its terminal voltage control. The system consists of a constant voltage controller, Sine Pulse-Width modulated voltage source inverter(PWM-VSI)and a battery for initial excitation. With the help of a closed loop control strategy, dc capacitor voltage is maintained constant inspite of changes in load. Thus Induction Generator can be operated at constant terminal voltage from no-load to full-load. Mathematical modelling of Self Excited Induction Generator feeding a RL load and driven by a wind turbine are developed in MATLAB/Simulink. Aforementioned system has been implemented experimentally using necessary hardware, 3.7 kW induction machine and control strategy has been implemented using TIs F28069M DSP processor. Both simulation and experimental results are discussed for varying load conditions.

articleTitle: Track Down of User Interest Based on Tweets
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The Sentiment analysis deals with identifying and classifying the opinions or sentiments expressed in form of text. Recently Social media have gained more attention. Public and private opinions about varied subjects are expressed and spread continually via numerous social media. Twitter is one of the social media that is gaining popularity. Thus the twitter is widely used for analyzing the sentiment of the huge groups. It is difficult to perform sentiment analysis in twitter in comparison with general sentiment analysis since the twitter contains many special characters, symbols, slang words and also has the limitation of 140 words. Knowledge base approach and Machine Learning approach are the two paths for analyzing the text. This paper proposes the sentiment analysis that can spot the interest and opinion of people in regard to the products such as e-Commerce sites, visualization tools, mobile products and network operators. This also includes the feature of classification of tweets into positive, negative and neutral based on the opinion of the people.

articleTitle: Design of Circular Patch Antenna for Indoor/Outdoor Positioning
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A circular patch antenna for indoor / outdoor positioning is designed for military personal. The goal is achieved with a truncated slot in a circular patch consisting of a single coaxial feed and a shorting via. It resonates at dual frequency band namely GPS band (1.575 GHz) and RFID band (915 MHz) achieving circular polarization. The simulated antenna has its main application in locating the military personal both in indoor and outdoor locations in case of emergency.

articleTitle: Identification of Human Characteristics through Speech using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Speech is the ability that helps humans to put ideas and thoughts into spoken words for effective communication. Speech recognition involves identification and conversion of human speech into binary values or machine code. A special relationship exists between speech features and human characteristics, speech features differ with different human characteristics. Human characteristics incorporates factors like age and gender of the subject. In this research for calculation of human characteristics, acoustic features of speech had been extracted. Age and gender prediction has several applications such as detection of mental age of children with special needs and in solving criminal cases.

articleTitle: Report on the Feasibility Study of E-Commerce Website Development for the Cooperative Store at College of Science and Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: New emerging technology has led to astounding inventions. One such invention on trend is online shopping which is a type of ecommerce technology. This innovation dates to 1991 after the first server and browser, World Wide Web by Tim Berners-Lee in 1990, was opened for commercial use. Then started many online shopping sites typically Amazon, eBay and Alibaba. This has influenced many customers to shop online thus, leaving the mundane way of visiting a store. Most importantly, it is much needed for the cooperative store and college to start having an independent e-commerce site so that everyone can adapt the trending technology. The main goal of this paper is to study the feasibility of developing e-commerce web portal for the college store. It only discusses how the hectic man work can be reduced and eased with the upcoming online service. It highlights the significance of popular ecommerce technology in reducing the human effort in shopping stores. To determine the attainability, online survey is carried out by circulating through college email service.107 people responded to the survey questionnaires of which majority are the students and few college staffs. The data collected is analyzed and the result shows a need for a website for the store which also facilitates online shopping. This paper clearly elaborates how an e-commerce web portal can be beneficial to everyone residing in college.

articleTitle: Integrated Rescue Group for Landslide Disaster Management
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The disaster situations such as earth slips, earthquakes and collapsing of high rise structures or tunnels demands immediate rescue of the affected. However, on studying the past incidents it was understood that rescue operations could not be launched immediately after an incident due to: nonavailability of infrastructure and detection systems of humans immediately onsite, risk of repetition of the occurrence such as further earth slips, limitations of detection at night times mostly after an earth slip occurred, natural reluctance of taking the risk of proceeding into danger by humans specially during dark hours. At this backdrop, it is well understood that there is an obvious limitation in surveillance and detection capability of human based rescue parties. Furthermore, the risk of utilizing further lives for rescue operations may not justify, if repetition of the occurrence is very much imminent. However, rescuing of the affected lives demands immediate attention and delaying the same may aggravate the possible endeavors as well as may nullify the effectiveness of further rescue efforts. This research endeavors to add an effective additional dimension to the disaster rescue operations by addition of movability, longer range and close vicinity surveillance by utilizing a group of quadcopter, crawling and earth piercing robots. All platforms are being equipped with a detector for thermal signature. The proposed solution keeps the humans at bay and could prevent risking human lives, but utterly risking the robots. Above all, this prevents the requirement of 24×7 based continuous monitoring, thereby provides some physical and psychological freedom to human rescue parties, who could be utilized else where such as providing first aid to the rescued humans.

articleTitle: VLSI Routing Optimization based on modified Constricted PSO with Iterative RLC Delay model
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Global interconnect delay is increasingly dominated with the scaling of VLSI fabrication technology where wire minimization, wire-sizing and buffer insertion techniques have found remarkable applications. Multiple researches are proven with state-of-art techniques to solve routing and timing optimization problem in VLSI. Metahueristic being an alternate approach, employed successfully Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Firefly Algorithm (FA) in RC delay Model and Binary PSO (BPSO) for iterative RLC delay model to obtain Global optimum but with limitations. This paper proposes a two-step approach using a modified Constricted PSO with mutation factor where the first stage achieves wire minimization and best buffer insertion with simultaneous wire-sizing in the final stage for reduction of interconnect delay using iterative RLC delay model. A comparison has been made between the conduct of the proposed approach and the previous BPSO approach and is found to be better alternative for optimizing VLSI Interconnect delay.

articleTitle: Optimal PWM in Three Level Inverter FED Induction Motor Drives with Quarter Wave Symmetry Relaxed
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: PWM waveforms are employed generally with Half Wave Symmetry (HWS) and Quarter Wave Symmetry (QWS) being preserved to minimize the harmonic distortion in the line current (ITHD) of the ac motor drives. This paper investigates ideal switching angles for a three-phase, three level inverter with HWS but without QWS for switching angles N=2 and N=3 per quarter of a cycle. With the suppression of the low order voltage harmonics, the performance of the proposed method is superior than the existing PWM technique with QWS in terms of total harmonic distortion (THD%) of line-line voltage for the complete range of modulation index (M). A complete Simulink model is developed to validate and confirm the theoretical outcomes for a three level inverter driving a 2.2kW squirrel cage induction motor.

articleTitle: A MatlablSimulink Based Five Level Cascaded Multilevel Inverter for PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents an efficient five level H-bridge CMLI (Cascaded Multilevel Inverter) topology for PV systems. At first maximum power from solar PV (photo voltaic) array is extracted by providing controlled duty cycle to DC-DC boost converter. Control of Duty cycle is done using P&O (Perturb and Observe) type MPPT (Maximum Power Point Tracking) algorithm. After that control switching pulses are applied to five-level CMLI for conversion of DC voltage into AC. Complete details of switching sequence of cascaded multilevel inverter and working parameters for PV array is presented in this paper. Simulation results of voltage and current waveform of PV array, stabilized output of MPPT and of CMLI is also shown.

articleTitle: Hybrid Clustering Algorithms for Crime Pattern Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Data mining can be used to model crime detection problems. Crimes are a social nuisance and cost our society dearly in several ways. Any research that can help in solving crimes faster will pay for itself. About 10% of the criminals commit about 50% of the crimes. Here we look at use of clustering algorithm for a data mining approach to help detect the crimes patterns and speed up the process of solving crime. We will look at Clustering techniques with some enhancements to aid in the process of identification of crime patterns. Without priori knowledge, determine the favorable condition of cluster algorithm imply problems. In this paper we propose a new two-level clustering algorithms and describing evaluation of the numbers of clusters which is involved to the validity of cluster and its stability by the way of learning. Before apply new two level algorithm, preprocessing cluster documentation has done. The main advantage of our proposed algorithm which is not limited and restricted to convex cluster. While compared to the conventional clustering methods, it can recognize illogically shaped clusters. The cost of this algorithm is better- quality to standard two-level clustering methods such as Affinity Propagation(AP) and RBF network and Affinity Propagation (AP) using costed approach and RBF network. The costed approach proves better than traditional Affinity Propagation.

articleTitle: Fault Tolerance in a Hardware Efficient Parallel FIR Filter
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Finite Impulse response filter is one of the fundamental devices in all digital processing system. Nowadays area efficient parallel FIR filter is most preferred in digital signal processing systems. In this research paper, such a filter is designed using carry select adder. For the reliable operation of filter, it must be protected. Filter protection is done using fault tolerant methods. Here the filtering effect of digital filter is analyzed by single error correction code. The experimental results show that the FIR filter designed is effective.

articleTitle: Implementation of Hamming coding in Residue Number System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The modern computation system is growing rapidly. Every computation depends on the general arithmetic operations that are indirectly involves decimal numbers. The decimal numbers are represented in binary notation. The decimal number system is very flexible to everyone and computations are easier than any other system. Even though there is problem while dealing with this decimal number system. With increase value of decimal number complexity increases. When these higher valued numbers are converted to binary number for computer computations, this leads huge usage of resources. The solution for this problem is RESIDUE number system. The RNS converts the huge valued number into group of small numbers, this makes computations easy and uses of less resources, which is the main advantage of the RNS system. From past twenty years research is going on Fault Detection and Isolation (FDI) and the focus here is to describe its application to stochastic systems. The complexity occurs while decoding the received encoded data. More often the transmitted data is subjected to the channel noise which influences the original signal. To overcome this problem many error correction codes (ECC`s) are introduced. This paper proposes an error detection and correction code called hamming code. The hamming code not only detects the errors as conventional codes but also it is able to correct the data. The property of error correction, detection and its simple nature can make this code popular. The process of hamming code and its architecture is described in the paper.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Enhancement of Wide-Slot Printed Antenna with Modified T-Shaped Parasitic Patches
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents the design of the printed wide-slot antenna with parasitic strips. Additional resonance is introduced in the higher frequency region by using a pair of parasitic strips. The enhanced bandwidth is 103% which is in range 2.24 GHz to 6.91 GHz and which is simulated successfully. Thus, the obtained bandwidth is approximately 1.5 times the bandwidth than that in which parasitic strips were not used. Antenna can be used for WiMAX (2.5/3.5/5.5 GHz) and WLAN (2.4/5.2/5.8 GHz) operation. Antenna can be employed for many wireless communications by choosing the appropriate dimensions of patches.

articleTitle: Towards Automated Book Identification and Cataloguing for an Online Library
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: We are in the era where people prefer the use of technology instead of traditional sources and are upgrading from real world approaches to virtual reality. An approach is made to create an online library, in which a model of the real world library is built, that provides features for the user to navigate into the library and not only select a book to read but also explore other books while navigating through it. The users can look around and browse books from the interactive library through a web browser, resulting in saving the time consumed for travelling. To detect a book of interest in the online library, our work focus on choosing an appropriate feature matching algorithm and further draw a boundary box on the book detected. The SURF algorithm provides better matching results compared to other feature detectors.

articleTitle: Model Fit using Regression Analysis for Personality and Psychological Capital Towards Stress Level among Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Stress is an emerging topic being studied with differing conceptualizations and has become an important issue in student's performance. The purpose of this paper is to find out the level of stress among the students whose doing higher studies. The main objective of this study is to find out the factors that are significant to create a stress that affect psychology and personality of students. By categorizing students under various factors like personality and psychological capital, these factors is used to determine the association among independent factors and demographic factor. Samples of 75 collected data have been studied over the statistical tools such as descriptive scrutiny, recognition, regression & chi square test. The outcomes reveal that the factors found that, extrovert, emotional stability personality factors influences inter/intra personal stress, conscientiousness, hope influences drive and desire related stress and agreeableness, resilience influences academic stress.

articleTitle: A Linearity Enhancement Technique for Cascode Opamp in 65nm CMOS Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper linearity of standard opamp and importance of this parameter for typical applications like continuous-time filters have been discussed. Out of few factors affecting the linearity, drain to source voltage of the differential pair has been root caused to this problem. A technique to improve the linearity by using a common mode feedback applied to the Cascode devices was proposed. A test circuit developed in 65nm CMOS technology to verify the robustness of the proposed technique and post-layout simulations shows 45% linearity improvement compared to the conventional architecture. Circuit operates at 1.2V and draws 235μA static current and test circuit occupies 4500um<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> silicon area.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis on Twitter Data: A New Aproach
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In today's world social media is most visiting sites. The twitter is most visited blogging site as it's easy to share opinion. Sentiment Analysis is ongoing research topic. The application of Sentiment Analysis is that it is applied for survey review, movies reviewed. In this system the main objective is to analysis tweets and result to positive, negative and neutral form. The additional feature is location recognition of tweets. In pre-processing the proposed system overcomes the slang with online as well as offline slang dictionary and fetch real time data. The real time tweets will help a user to know about current facts. The spell correction is important pre-processing part overcome in this system. The name and entity extraction will let user know that tweets belong to any people or organization. The location of tweets could be used for any product review, political issues view, etc. the additional feature of location make system different and slang replacement increase the accuracy of system and make system more reliable. The system applied technique lie naïve bayes and semi supervised. The output is displayed in form of pie charts or bar graphs.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Voltage Swell Characteristics in Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Voltage swell characterization is an important, because power quality analysis, troubleshooting, diagnosis, and mitigation policy could be carried out only after characterizing the voltage swells. The magnitude, duration, and phase-angle jump are the essential characteristics of voltage swell are considered in this work. In this paper, the simulation process of the proposed system is carried out by using MATLAB/SIMULINK environment to compare the significant characteristics of voltage swells under different cases such as energizing a capacitor bank, system fault, sudden switching a linear and nonlinear load.

articleTitle: Automation Framework Development for Continuous Integration and Deployment in CT Machines Using LXC and Docker Container Lightweight Virtualization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In the present enterprise level, computer system assets are supreme to the point that they frequently have surplus limit. It is legitimate practice to devote singular system to a individual application. Only some applications utilize limited running power, yet with the utilization of local techniques and advances, a large number of PCs will be utilized particularly with regards to a completely fledged industry. Virtualization comes into picture here where the manager can solidify a huge number of individual PCs to a solitary server. Virtualization supports new chances to server farm management, letting client's assured uptime of servers and as well as applications, speedy disaster recovery, Instant deployment of new virtual machines, Elasticity, Reconfiguration of running computing environments without affecting the clients/users. Virtualization plays a vital role in improving maintenance of healthcare devices such as CT machines. There are several CT machines which are running with a very naïve technology for which specific number of resources such CPU, memory, processing, labour must be dedicated which is definitely a huge wastage of resources. Using virtualization techniques, resources can be used in an effective manner, and there is a need to develop an automated framework which should be language independent and supports cross platform by which unification of different CT models can be done. This framework also automates many manual tasks related to CT machines reducing the man power and indirectly reduces the manual mistakes.

articleTitle: A Survey on Accelerating Crypto Operation
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The thought of coding has long been employed by militaries and government to facilities secret communication. Currently coding is often accustomed shield sensitive data sent over the net, email, e-banking, mobile banking, internet server mistreatment std coding technique. These days SSL de-facto code coding std accepted over the planet is enforced to supply net security. Numerous researches have enforced SSL on numerous code platforms and solutions that overload the net server's electronic equipment and impede the whole operation. This survey paper provides the thought of implementing SSL protocol on hardware platform in novel and innovative thanks to come through hardware fast and different technological edges and build it real time.

articleTitle: Hiding Three Binary Images in a Grayscale Image with Pixel Matching Steganography and Randomization technique
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents a method to hide three binary images in a grayscale image with same resolution. Pseudo Random Number Generator(PRNG) produces the random numbers that rearranges the binary values. PRNG algorithm is unique and the strength of random numbers generated are equal to random numbers generated without a seed value. Each binary image pixel values are rearranged through three random number series and it is hidden in a grayscale image through Ultra Unique Numbers (UUN). By comparing both concealed image and original image, modification among the image is identified. To identify concealed secret binary information in a grayscale image at the destination, UUN is reapplied. PRNG is used to rearrange the binary values for transforming the binary images. The main aim of this paper is to increase the embedding capacity of carter image without degrading the quality of the secret information with high Peak Signal Noise Ratio(PSNR).

articleTitle: Enhancement of Signal Strength of Single Antenna Wi-Fi Routers
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Wi-Fi is the most common communication technology used as Local Area Networks for day to day business or personal communications these days. In many homes and workplaces single antenna routers are used. These single antenna routers are Omni directional and radiates energy equally in all the directions. In a home network, the signal strength need to be focussed in one direction. This Omnidirectional nature of single antenna routers causing wastage of energy and also provides reduced signal strength in desired direction. In this paper authors made an attempt to make signals focussed in one useful direction with increased signal strength in the desired direction. A parabolic reflector has been designed to direct the signals of the single antenna routers in a single direction. Extensive experimentation has been conducted in various home networks with the proposed reflector and the signal strength of the router has been found to be increased by 40%.

articleTitle: Practical Approach for Implementation of Phase Correlation Based Image Registration in FPGA
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents a practical approach for implementing phase correlation algorithm in presence of image noise. We propose Gradient filter implementation for edge enhancement to retrieve the translational shift using phase correlation method. We have implemented the filter in FPGA in an optimum way. With this improved phase correlation method we are able to achieve the sub pixel shift even in presence of noise and smear with only condition that image should have at least 10% contrast ratio.

articleTitle: Comparison of 3-Phase 3-Wire Shunt Active Power Filters through Current Control Topologies
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper presents comparison of different current control topology for the three phase three wire shunt active power filter with six switch voltage source converter. The comparison of four methods namely, constant power theory, Sinusoidal current control topology (SSC), Fryze current control theory, synchronous reference frame theory (SRF) is carried out in this paper. All these methods are discussed and simulated in MATLAB/Simulink for different supply conditions.

articleTitle: Routing Customer Based on Google Map using MUGANO Protocol for Commercial Purpose Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Big data storage is a storage infrastructure that is modeled for store, manage and retrieve large amount of data and it is able to give flexibility to the software. Then Google map generally shows the nearby commercial places such as hospital, Market, Jeweler shop, Retail store with distance, but in this paper, we discuss about MUGANO (Mobility Updated Graphical Alphanumeric OTP) protocol which is used to incorporate Google map location with commercial place details and available items. Moreover, customer familiarization the private sector locations will be dynamically changed. So we want to overcome this issue, our proposed protocol will easily update the private sector location information automatically using graphical alphanumeric OTP.

articleTitle: Improved Inverter Control for DFIG Based WES Connected to Weak Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The control scheme is proposed for inverter control to improve the synchronization and power quality of the wind energy system (WES) connected to the weak grid without phase locked loop (PLL). Droop based control scheme is proposed to obtain the improved performance under different operating conditions. In this paper, the proposed control scheme is designed and implemented for the WES to improve the dynamic and transient response. The DFIG based WES is modeled in MATLAB SIMULINK to validate the improvement in power quality and synchronization of DFIG based WES with proposed control scheme. The results are also discussed to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: Power Quality Improvement in IEEE-39 RTS System by Using DATATCOM: Mitigation of Voltage Sag Analytically
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In the distribution system, most of the power quality problems are associated with voltage sag. As a consequence, divergent solutions have been hunted to compensate this voltage sag to evade financial losses in commercial industries. Distribution Static Compensator (D-STATCOM) is now turning into more recognized in commercial industries to reduce the bad impacts of voltage sag in sensitive loads. The D-STATCOM is placed in shunt with a sensitive load and possesses the ability to respond speedily against the voltage sag experienced by sensitive equipment of end user. This paper explained shunt reactive injection. The suggested methodology is to establish analytical aspects and to demonstrate this by a case study of 39 bus IEEE RTS system. Voltage sag can be eradicated by continuous injection of very small Voltage or reactive power to the system. The scheme incorporates the method of instantaneous symmetrical components.

articleTitle: Automatic Variable Length Summarized Video using Motion of Object
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Video summarization is a process of creating and presenting a meaningful abstract view of entire video within a reduced period of time. Video summarization facilitates quick browsing of activities present in longer video. Here we are presenting an automatic video summarization method to create a summarized video of variable length from original video. Summarized video is a highly temporally condensed representation of video to give an overview of different activities present in the video so that we are extracting multiple events from original video to show multiple activities in original form. Here we are using motion of object and object tracking using blob matching over a video sequence. Summarized video also preserves chronological order i.e. relative timing between activities.

articleTitle: Design and Enactment of Bendable Micro Strip Probe for Wireless Bids
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A smaller rectangular microstrip radio wire with conservative length is intended to cover 2.54 GHz in this paper. The recieving wire geometry joins a roundabout opening. Roundabout polarization is accomplished by the utilization of truncating niche strategy. This reception apparatus is mollified by method for co-hub bolster. It is imprinted on bendy substrate (denims material texture). Meta-fabric shape is additionally used to enhance the pick up of the recieving wire. The parameters alongside return misfortune, radiation design, radiation effectiveness and hub proportion are broke down utilizing HFSS programming. The recieving wire is created for improved measurements and inspected utilizing a vector group analyzer.

articleTitle: A New Design of Dual Band Antenna for Wireless Applications At 2.4/3.5/5.2/5.5/5.8ghz
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: This paper proposes a dual band printed patch antenna with defected ground structure. A V and C shaped resonating strips are attached to the 50 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\Omega$</tex> microstrip line which is used to feed the proposed antenna. The impedance bandwidth of the proposed antenna is from (2.2-3.57GHz) in lower band and from (3.7GHz-6.3GHz) in upper band. The antenna parameters are adjusted in such a way so that it covers the required frequency ranges. The antenna covers 2.4/3.5/5.2/5.8GHz for various wireless applications for example WLAN at (2.4/5.2/5.8GHz)/ WiMAX at (2.5/5.5GHz). All the results have been simulated successfully.

articleTitle: MMD Labeling of Butterfly Networks
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: A graph G with n vertices is said to have modular multiplicative divisor (MMD) labeling if there exist a bijection f from vertices of G to the set of all natural numbers from 1 to n and for all uv ∈ E(G) the edge labels as f(u)f(v)(mod n) such that n divides the sum of all edge labels of G. This paper studies the existence of MMD labeling of a butterfly networks which is a remarkable interconnection networks.

articleTitle: Multilayered and Multiband SRR Loaded CB-CPW Fed Antenna for On-Body Monitoring Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The SRR loaded circular ring encircled by an proposed structure with conductor backed coplanar wave guide fed with small size antenna is outstandingly necessary part for wearable transceiver device module for healthcare interfacing application. This antenna designed to fine-tune at resonating frequency 3.5GHz, 3.66GHz, 4.1GHz, 6.7GHz, and 9.3GHz. The simulated results for the magnitude of reflection coefficients are -14dB at 3.5GHz, -13dB at 2.48GHz, -35dB at 4.1GHz, -31dB at 6.7GHz, -40dB at 9.3GHz, for the proposed wearable antenna. These values are more suitable for standard UWB band and other wireless interfacing communication bands.

Author Keywords: UWB band and other interfacing communication bands

articleTitle: Model Fit Using Regression Equation-Personality of Engineering Students and their Academic Performance
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Personality indicates the behavioural and emotional characteristics of an individual and this paper helps to analyse whether the students' academic performance is strongly influenced by their personality based characteristics by conducting survey among the engineering students of different branch of study in Thanjavur District. The major study objectives are to identify the factors that are significant and to which extent the factors of personality and academic performance measures are correlated. Here, in this paper independent factors of personality which is considered to identify the relationship among demographic factors, independent factors and academic performance of students are Extroversion, Agreeableness, Conscientiousness, Emotional stability and Openness. Data has been collected from engineering students among different branches with a sample size of 75 and can be examined with the help of statistical tools like descriptive analysis, regression & Chi-square test. The results reveal that the factors found that, independent factors of personality like conscientiousness, agreeableness and openness influences the academic performance of student.

articleTitle: Broadband Circularly Polarized U-Slot Antenna for Wireless Application
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The antenna presented in this paper is a broadband circularly polarized U slot antenna. The circularly polarized radiation is achieved in this paper by suspending two separated rectangular strips from the inner edge of ground and using inverted L-shaped central feeding stub. The L-shaped stub is oriented at 90 degree with respect to grounded strips. The impedance bandwidth of the antenna proposed here varies from (4.68 - 6.42 GHz) which is 31.3% and the axial ratio bandwidth is from (5.15-6.45 GHz) which is 22.4% for WLAN (ranging from 5.15 to 5.85 GHz) and WIMAX (5.8GHz,5.5 GHz) applications. The antenna is left and right hand circularly polarized in and directions respectively. A wide notch is cut from the ground which enhances the ARBW by 51.35% in comparison to simple square shaped ground. All the results have been simulated successfully.

articleTitle: MPPT Based Non-Isolated Step-up Converter for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: PV has the range of applications for tomorrow but due to unpredictable output in nature it requires modification before use. Proposed step up converter based on the two principles of coupled inductor and diode capacitor technique. Which lead to give higher output conversion and greater efficiency. Maximum Power Point Tracking(MPPT) is used to modify the efficiency of PV. This system is applicable for fuel cell, HID head lamps, vehicles.

articleTitle: Comparison of Isolated and Continuous Text Models for Voice Based Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: In this paper, a comparative study has been made between isolated and continuous text models for developing a voice based attendance system. A GUI application has been designed for testing a two layer authentication system for attendance system, the second layer being speech biometrics. Users were pre-enrolled in the system before using the application. For both the speech models, different combinations of feature vectors and classifiers were experimented. Various statistical parameters like mean and variance were studied for threshold evaluation. Final models were developed with MFCC feature and GMM classifier. Overall accuracy of the system for isolated text model and continuous text model is reported as 62.67% and 53.6% respectively.

articleTitle: An Effective Framework to Enhance Intelligent Transport Systems using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Mobile ad hoc networks are employed in different fields which include rescue missions, battlefields and recently in inter-vehicular networks, known as Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs). There has been lot of research works done on the use of VANETs in traffic safety in road networks. Efforts are done to achieve these objectives but many drawbacks have been recorded such as an expensive cost of the service in which the user is required to buy the service and its resources (software, infrastructure and/or platform). A framework of ad hoc cloud network architecture and incorporating the concepts of intelligent transport systems mechanical devices and systems using cloud computing is discussed.

articleTitle: Automatic Liquid Mixing and Filling Using PLC
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: The aspiration of this endeavor is to design and develop the programmable logic controller based liquid mixing and filling. This endeavor will provide high exactitude and pliability to the system and at the same time it will provide accurate volume of liquid in bottle by saving operational time. The system sequence of operation is being designed by ladder diagram. The components used in this work are programmable logic controller (PLC), proximity sensor, solenoid valves and DC Motors, which consists of three sections such as the conveyor section, filling section and mixing section. This work will be useful in paint industries and concrete industries.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of PWM Techniques to Feed Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2018 International Conference on Current Trends towards Converging Technologies (ICCTCT)
abstract: Multilevel Inverter (MI) is extensively used in industries to change the output voltage and frequency of drive. MI is not only serving in industries but also in domestic applications. PWM plays an important role to control the switching of multilevel inverter. This paper depicts the analysis & comparison of various Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) techniques for multilevel inverter to the PMSM drive in order to control speed and torque. Out of all PWM, the discussed PWM are sinusoidal pulse width modulation (SPWM) & Hysteresis PWM (HPWM). To prepare the results of various PWM techniques, these various techniques are connected to Five Level Cascaded Inverter (FLCI).
